tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor chen po'i dbang gi cho ga bzhugs so//

"$ ༄༅// dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal ldan phung po khams dang skye mched rang bzhin dkyil 'khor rnam dag pa// rgyal ba'i dbang gis rnam par sbyangs nas bskyed dang rdzogs dang rnam par sbyor// dri med 'bras bu dpal ldan mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i ye shes ni// mngon sum ston mdzad bla ma mchog la lus ngag yid gsum phyag 'tshal lo// dpal ldan mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho yi// dbang bskur cho ga'i rim pa ni// bla ma'i man ngag rim pa bzhin// gsal bar 'dir ni bstan par bshad// dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur bar byed pa la don rnam pa gsum ste/ slob dpon dang*/ slob ma/ cho ga'i rim pa'o// dang po ni/ rgyud las/ sems can kun la phan bdag nyid// mi 'jigs pa ni stong nyid dang*// sngags dang rgyud kyi sbyor ba shes// sbyor ba bzo dang sgyu rtsal sogs// mthun pa'i ngag dang thams cad la// bu cig pa dang mthun pa dang*// stong pa la sogs rtag tu dga'// bsam gtan ting 'dzin de mchog gzhol// ji ltar smras pa de bzhin byed// 'tshe ba med cing bden pa'i ngag /sems can kun la thugs brtse dang*// lam du 'dzud pa de mthar phyin// kun mkhyen yon tan dang mnyam dang*// bstan bcos kun gyi pha rol son// mgon med rnams kyi pha dang ma// phyag rgya brda' ni byed pa po// zhes bya ba gsungs pa dang*/ gzhan rgyud thams cad nas gsungs pa'i mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i rdo rje slob dpon no// slob ma yang*/ dad dang thos sogs yon tan ldan// snying rje ldan zhing bstan bcos mkhas// dam tshig bsrung zhing gtong phod che// bsgrub la mngon par gzhol ba'o// dbang bskur ba'i cho ga la yang rnam pa gsum ste/ sngon du bya ba dang*/ dngos gzhi dang*/ rjes kyi dkyil 'khor gshegs gsol gyi cho ga'o// dang po ni/ slob ma bsrung ba dang*/ bsnyen pa'i rim pa ni gnyis las/

sarba ta thā ga ta ka ya wa ga tsi ta pra ṇa mi ṇa badz+ra bhan dha ni/ ka ru me/ zhes phyag 'tshal nas/ dpal ldan mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes lan gsum du gsol ba gdab bo// de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyis snying rje ba'i sems kyis sems can thams cad drang ba'i bsam pa nye bar bzhag ste/ 'di skad ces brjod de/ 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor bying ba ni// de rnams nyon mongs 'dam gyis gos// rgal bar mi nus pa'i sems can// shin tu sdug bsngal tshogs rnams dang*// nyan thos la sogs bsgral ba dang*// byang chub sems dpa' rgyal ba'i sras/ dpa' rnams bde chen thob pa yin// 'khor lo bcu gnyis dri ma spangs/ bla na med pa'i dkyil 'khor du// rab tu 'jug par khyod spro'am// zhes brjod la/ slob mas kyang bdag spro'o zhes brjod do// de nas slob ma de mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho zhal gcig phyag gnyis par bskyed la sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs nas/ go cha'i bsrung ba bya ste/ oṃ ha snying kha la/ na ma hi mgo la/ sa hā hūm̐ spyi gtsug bā+au sha ṭa he phrag pa la/ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho mig la/ phaṭa haṃ lpags pa'i mthar thug par bsams nas/ bdud rtsi'i chu yis khrus byas nas yo byad rnams bsgrub par bya'o// slob dpon gyis sngon du bsnyen pa bya ste/ rang gi lha'i rnal 'byor ni/ mngon par rtogs pa bshad pa ni// rim pas legs par bsgom ldan pas// bdag po'i rim pa 'bum phra gcig /yum gyi de phyed 'khor gyi khri// gsang sngags rgyal po ma nyams bzla// zhes gsungs pa bzhin du bya'o// dngos gzhi la yang rnam pa gsum ste/ sa chog dang*/ lhag par gnas pa'i sta gon dang*/ dbang bskur ba dngos gzhi'o// dang po ni/ bkra shis pa'i sa phyogs su/ rang nyid lha'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pas/ sa phyogs de'i bdag por gyur pa rnams dang*/ dur khrod kyi 'byung po'i tshogs la spyi gtor bzhin du gtor ma byin la/

pus nub tsam du sa rkos la brtag par bya'o// bram ze dkar po shes byas te// ser po rgyal po'i rigs su 'dod// rje'u rigs dmar por shes byas ste// nag po dmangs rigs rab tu grags// sa yi cha ni sbyang bar bya// thod pa rtsa ba rus pa skra// phub ma rdo ba gseg ma dang*// thal ba sol ba srin thag ni// khru do tsam du brkos la spang*// ji ltar stegs bu bya ba yang*/ gzhan dag rgyal po la khru brgya// mtha' skyong rnams kyis de yi phyed// gtso bo rnams kyis de yi phyed gsungs// tshong dpon rnams kyi khru bcu gnyis// bsgrub pa rnams kyi khru brgyad pa// rang gi ji ltar nus pas bri// zhes gsungs pas/ skyon med pa'i kha dog dang ldan pa'i bzang ba'i mtshan ma'o// dkyil du kong byas la chu bkang nas shar phyogs su gom pa brgya song la phyir log nas ma skams na bzang ba'i mtshan ma'o// de ltar sa brtags nas/ sbyang pa ni/ rus pa dang sol ba la sogs pa'i skyon thams cad bsal la/ ga pur/ si la/ gla rtsi/ tsan dan/ a ru ra ste/ sman gyi bdud rtsi lnga po 'di dang*/ gzhan dag sa bzang po 'di dag bsres la/ dkyil 'khor gyi stegs bu dbus mtho ba/ byang dang shar gzhol ba legs par bya ste/ rin po che lnga dang*/ 'bru lnga dang*/ bdud rtsi rnam pa lnga'i thal ba yang gzhug cing sa 'thas pa legs par bcag la/ de ltar las dang bya ba sbyangs nas/ de nas de'i phyi rol du dkyil 'khor gyi khang pa gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs dang bcas pa rgyan pa byas te/ der lugs ma dang thang ka dang po ti dang bla re dang me tog gi phreng ba dang dri zhim po dang bdug spos dang mar me rnams bkram pa dang sna tshogs pa'i gos rnams kyis brgyan par bya'o// de nas stegs bu'i dbus su/ sngar bshad pa'i dri bzang po'i chag chag btab la/ mchod pa'i tshogs dang*/ me tog gi tshom bu cig dang*/ sa'i lha mo'i mchod yon dang*/ gtor ma bshams te/

rang nyid dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i mngon rtogs thig le dkyil 'khor ram/ zhal cig phyag gnyis pa'i mngon rtogs bsgoms la/ snying kha'i sngags kyi 'od zer gyis/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang*/ yul sum cu so drug gi dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs dang*/ 'jig rten skyong ba rnams mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs la/ chu bzhi dang*/ phyi nang gi mchod pa rnams kyis mchod de/ gsol ba gdab pa ni/ rdo rje dril bu dang spos bzung nas/ phyogs bcu dus gsum bzhugs pa yi// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*// mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i rang bzhin gyis// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma'i 'khor lo// tshangs dang brgya byin la sogs pa// gang dag bstan la mngon dga' ba// rdo rje'i spyan dang ldan pa yi// 'byung po mthu chen thams cad kun// bdag la dgongs par mdzad du gsol// rdo rje 'dzin pa'i che ge bdag /mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho dkyil 'khor che// sems can don du bgyid par 'tshal// kun gyis byin gyis brlab tu gsol// zhes gsol ba gdab bo// de nas sa'i lha mo bskul bar bya ste/ rang gi lag pa g.yas pa zla ba'i dkyil 'khor las 'od zer 'phros te/ rdo rje rtse gsum gyi phyag rgyas hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ zhes lan gsum du sa la bsnun par byas te/ skad cig gis sa'i lha mo kha dog ser mo/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yon bum pa bsnams pa/ g.yas mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgya/ rin po che'i rgyan dang ldan pa/ skad cig gis gsal bar bltas la/ pra ti dhi bi sa pa ri wa ra argaṃ pra ti dza ye swāhā/ zhes mchod yon dbul/ de bzhin du pa t+yaṃ/ a dza ma nam̐/ pro k+ṣa nam̐/ zhes bya bas/ zhabs bsil/ 'thor 'thung rnams phul la/ de nas phyi'i mchod pa me tog la sogs pa dang*/ nang gi mchod pa phul nas/ bstod pa ni/ ma ma rin chen sna tshogs 'dzin// lha mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma// sku phyed thon te gser gyi mdog

/rin chen sna tshogs rgyan gyis brgyan// g.yon pa'i phyag na bum pa dang*/ g.yas pa mi 'jigs sbyin par mdzad// sgyu 'phrul sna tshogs zhal mnga' ma// sa 'og lha mo khyod la bstod// zhes brjod nas gsol ba gdab pa ni/ skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// spyod tshul khyad par rnams gsum ni// sa dang pha rol phyin pa la// lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur// shākya seng ge skyob pa yis// ji ltar bdud kyi sde bcom pa// de bzhin bdag gi bdud las ni// rgyal bar byas te dkyil 'khor bri// zhes brjod nas/ gnang ba byin par bsams la/ yang mchod yon dang gtor ma la sogs phul la/ sa de nyid du thim par bsam mo// oṃ badz+ri bha ba hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra ḍṇā ḍi tishtha zhes brjod pas sa'i cho ga'o// 'di ltar sbyang ba mi dgos pa'i sa ni/ kha bzangs rdo'i steng gzhi dang ni// gtsug lag khang dang zhabs kyis bcags// ba glang lhas dang rgya mtsho'i 'gram// der ni sbyang ba bya mi dgos// rang rang snying po brgya rtsa bzla// zhes rdo rje mkha' 'gro las so// de ltar nyi ma dang po byas nas/ de nas gnyis pa'i snga dro rang nyid dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su 'dug ste/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i mngon rtogs rgyas pa'am/ snying po thig le'i mngon rtogs gsal bar bsgoms la/ bdud rtsi myang ba'i bar du byas nas/ slar legs par bslabs pa'i slob ma rnams kyis/ shar la sogs pa phyogs bzhi nas/ mkha' 'gro ma nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyi nga rgyal gyis mchod pa dang bstod pa/ rig ma bcu drug dang*/ gho ri/ la sogs pa'i sngags kyis mchod nas/ shar phyogs nas bskul ba ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun zhi ba// de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas// chos kun bdag med pa yi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol// de bzhin du byang phyogs nas/ sems can kun gyi sems chen po// rang bzhin dag pa dri ma med// kun tu bzang po thugs kyi mchog

/dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol// nub phyogs nas/ zhi ba'i chos mchog las byung ba'i// ye shes spyod pa rnam sbyong ba// kun du bzang po gsung gi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bstan du gsol// lho phyogs nas/ mtshan nyid thams cad yang dag rdzogs// mtshan nyid min pa thams cad spangs// kun tu bzang po sku yi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bstan du gsol// zhes glu dang bcas pas bskul nas/ de nas lha'i nga rgyal brtan po dang ldan pas sems dga' ba bskyed de/ deng 'dir bdag skyes 'bras bu yod// bdag gi 'tsho ba 'bras bu bcas// dam tshig lha rnams thams cad dang*// bdag ni mnyam 'gyur the tshom med// bdag gi nyi ma deng mchog yin// deng bdag mchog sbyin bla na med// sangs rgyas kyis rjes brtse ba yi// bka' lung thob par bdag gis shes// zhes brjod nas/ sangs rgyas thams cad la phyag 'tshal bar mos te/ rkang pa gnyis su aḥdang hūm̐ las rdo rje dang me'i tshogs 'phro bar bsgom mig g.yas su ma las nyi ma'i 'od zer 'phro ba/ g.yon du aṃ las bdud rtsi'i tshogs 'bab pa bsgoms te/ byang shar mtshams nas rdo rje'i 'gros kyis 'gro ste/ ma lus phyogs nas bzhugs pa yi// sangs rgyas thams cad bdag la dgongs// bdag ni dpal ldan rdo rje 'dzin// bka' yi 'khor lo spro ba'o// lha dang lha min gsang ba pa// brjed byed la sogs bgegs kyi tshogs// sa 'dir ma 'dug gzhan du dengs// gal te bka' las 'das 'gyur na// 'khor lo me ltar 'bar ba yis// 'jigs par gyur pa gdon mi za// gang su dag /lha dang lha ma yin dang gnod sbyin dang srin po dang yi dwags dang sha za dang brjed byed dang 'byung po dang mkha' 'gro ma dang gnon po dang rgad po dang rgan mo dang rjes su spyod pa'i 'khor dang*/ nam mkha' lding dang mi'am ci dang skyes bu sngags grub pa rnams sa'i phyogs 'dir slob dpon che ge mo zhes bya ba'i yang dag pa'i byang chub sems yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i don dang*/

sems can thams cad kyis bla na med pa'i ye shes thob par bya ba'i rgyur dpal he ru ka mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho 'khor lo bcu gnyis su mngon par brjod pa'i dkyil 'khor bdag gis bya'o// dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i bka' 'di thos nas myur du 'gro bar gyis shig gang zhig mi 'gro na de la bdag dpal he ru ka rdo rje rab tu 'bar ba'i hūm̐ zhes brjod pa dang rab tu khros pa'i zhal can kun nas 'bar bas ye shes chen po'i rdo rjes spyi bo brgya 'gas par bya'o// zhes brjod cing sngags pas g.yas su lan gsum bskor bar bya'o// bgegs thams cad 'bros par bsam mo// dbang ldan phyogs nas brtsams nas ni// rdo rje snyems par rol bcas pas// g.yas brkyang dbyug 'phen dpa' ba'i nyams// g.yon brkyang mda' 'phen mi sdug pa// sa gad gad mo de bzhin zhi/ zlum po gtun shin 'jigs rung ba// de la sogs pa'i gar gyis ni// g.yas dang g.yon gyis rnam pas bskor// rtsa ba'i gar ni 'di dag gam// spros pa la dga' na blta stangs drug cu rtsa bzhi pa bya'o// de nas phur bus gdab par bya ste/ de nas bdag nyid rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad 'bar ba'i me dang 'dra bar bsgoms te hūm̐ zhes brjod pa dang*/ snying kha nas he ru ka zhal cig phyag gnyis pa rdo rje dang thod pa thogs pa dpag tu med pa mdun du phyung la sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab pa byas nas/ oṃ sum bha ni la sogs pa brjod pas/ bgegs kyi bdag po thams cad bkug ste/ me la sogs pa'i gra bzhir bzhag nas seng ldeng las byas pa'i phur bu/ nam mkha'i snying po dang pad ma gar gyi dbang phyug dang*/ rnam par snang mdzad dang rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bo bzhi byas te/ oṃ badz+ra ki li ki la ya hūm̐ zhes brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas te/ g.yas dang g.yon gyi bskor bar byas nas bgegs la phur bus gdab par bya ste/ oṃ gha gha/ gha ta ya gha ta ya/

sarba duṣ+ṭa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ki la ya ki la ya sarba pa pām̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ hūm̐ hūm̐ badz+ra dha ra a dzña pa ya sti sarba duṣ+ṭan badz+ra ki la ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces rdo rje phur bu btsugs la/ oṃ badz+ra mud ka ra a ko ṭa ya a ko ṭa ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa zhes rdo rje'i tho bas brdungs nas bgegs thams cad bde ba chen pa'i nyams su myong bar bya ste/ slar yang rdo rje dang rin po che dang pad ma dang rgya gram 'khor lo'i ra ba rnams bsgom zhing*/ me'i mtshams bcings nas/ khro bo rta mgrin bskal pa'i me 'bar ba glog gi mdog can/ ljags 'dril ba drag po chen po bsams te bgegs lhag ma 'joms par bsgom mo// de nas bcom ldan 'das 'khor dang bcas pa nam mkha'i khams su gsal bar bltas nas mchod de/ bstod pa bya ba ni/ he ru ka dpal ye shes che// rnal 'byor chen po mthu chen po// mgon po chen po byed pa che// theg pa chen po shing rta che// gsung pa chen po shes rab che/ dpa' bo chen po don chen mdzad// 'dzin pa chen po nga rgyal che/ rgyal po chen po mchod pa che// srid pa chen po sim pa che// rol pa chen po gnas chen po// mtshon cha chen po drag chen po// bzhad pa chen po dka' thub che// zhe sdang chen po 'dod chags che// gti mug chen po stobs chen po// snun pa chen po sgra chen po// bsnyems pa chen po stobs po che// sku gsum lam gsum cha byad can// 'khor lo gsum dang srid gsum mchog /dri ma gsum spangs dge ba gsum// spyan gsum sum cu gsum dbang phyug /srid pa gnon pa srid rtse'i mchog /srid pa ldan pa srid las 'das// srid pa dngos med srid snang ba// srid pa'i steng ma srid gtso bo// rnal 'byor spyod pa rnal 'byor che// rnal 'byor ma yi rnal 'byor brtson// sbyor shes rnal 'byor las yongs byung*// rnal 'byor rnal 'byor mngon 'joms po// rdo rje dbang phyug dpal dgyes pa// rdo rje'i phreng bas rnam par brgyan// rdo rje kha ngam phrad pa'i lus// rdo rje rdo rje'i phyag chen po// rdo rje'i gar ni brtan pa che// rdo rje'i glu ni sgra chen po// rdo rje pad+ma'i ting 'dzin bzhugs// rdo rje'i gdan ni dga' bar dgyes// bde ba'i bzhes pa thob pa ste// 'od kyis skye bo skyong ba po// lus ngag yid kyis thams cad du// khyod la gus pas bdag nyid 'dud// mkha' 'gro'i drwa ba la phyag 'tshal// phyag 'tshal mkha' 'gro yid dam la// stong nyid ye shes la phyag 'tshal// stong pa'i thugs la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes bya ba dang*/

e ma'o chos e ma'o chos// e ma'o chos kyi don byung pa// chos bdag pa'i don bdag med// rdo rje rgyal po phyag 'tshal 'dud// sku gsung thugs ni shin tu dag /nam mkha' mnyam pa nyid kyi gnas// rnam par 'gyur med snang ba med// rdo rje'i sku la phyag 'tshal 'dud// de bzhin gshegs pa thugs kyi gtso// dus gsum lam la gnas pa ste// go skabs chen po'i dbyings byung pa// nam mkha' la ni phyag 'tshal 'dud/ nam mkha'i sku ni yang dag byung*// nam mkha'i gsung ni rab 'jug pa// nam mkha'i thugs ni chos kyi mchog /spyod pa'i go 'phang phyag 'tshal 'dud// rdo rje sems dpa' theg pa che// nam mkha'i spyod pa rnam sbyong ba/ kun tu bzang po mchod pa'i mchog /rgyal ba mchog gis mchod pa gsungs// 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug che// rdo rje theg pa nyer ston pa// nam mkha'i khams dang mnyam pa'i mchog /rgyal ba mchog gis mchod pa gsungs// thar pa'i lam gyis rab sgrol ba// theg gsum mchog lam gnas pa po// sangs rgyas bskal bzang dag pa'i bdag /don yod mchod pa mi yi mchog /byang chub sems ni yangs pa'i spyan// chos kyi 'khor lo rab bskor ba// sku gsung thugs ni yongs su dag /rdo rje theg pa phyag 'tshal lo// zhes bya ba la sogs pas bstod do// sa'i cho ga'o// gnyis pa lhag par gnas pa la bzhi ste/ dang po sbyin bsreg lhag par gnas pa ni/ skabs dang sbyar nas cho ga las byung ba bzhin du bya'o// lha sta gon dang*/ bum pa sta gon dang*/ slob ma sta gon no// maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus su/ rtsa ba'i thig brgyad dang*/ 'khor lo bcu gnyis kyi lha'i gnas btsal na/ dri bzang po'i chus dbus su gru bzhi/ gzhan rnams bzlum po'i thig bya ste/ de nas rang rang gi sngags brjod cing me tog gi tshom bu dgod par bya'o// de nas gtso bo'i gnas su ram̐ yongs su gyur pa las/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/

hūm̐ sngon po las de yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa lte ba'i nyi ma la hūm̐ bsams te/ de las 'khor lo bcu gnyis spros te 'gro ba dag par byas te de nyid kyi rnam par byas pa dang*/ gdod ma nas grub pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad bkug ste zhugs pa'i yongs su gyur pa las lha thams cad dus cig tu bskyed do// go cha yang byas te/ de nas de nyid kyi thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyi bdag nyid kyi lus ngag yid kyi sbyor ba las/ oṃ badz+ra maṇ+ḍal hūm̐ dzaḥ ye shes sems dpa' dgug par bya'o// oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya gu h+ya maṇ+ḍal lam̐/ zhes bya bas gzhug par bya'o// oṃ badz+ra tsakra a dhi ti shtha sid dh+ya hūm̐ zhes bya bas byin gyis brlab par bya'o// de nas lha thams cad kyi sngags ma lus pa brjod la yang byin gyis brlab par bya'o// dbang bskur ba dang rigs kyi bdag pos rgyas gdab pa bya ste/ mchod yon la sogs pa nas phyi'i mchod pa khyad par thams cad dang*/ lha mo brgyad dang bcu drug spros la mchod par bya'o// rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas bstod pa ma lus pa bya'o// chang dang bdud rtsi dang bcas pa pad ma'i snod bzang po la gnas pa la gtor ma sbyong ba'i cho gas sbyangs te/ lha thams cad kyis sngags brjod cing tshim par bya'o// de nas bdug spos lag tu thogs nas snyan gsan dbab par byas te/ phyogs bcu'i rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ni// sras bcas 'jig rten la grags dang*// rdo rje rin chen rigs dang yang*// pad ma las kyi rigs de bzhin// snying po phyag rgya sngags rig pa'i// gang zhig lha yi tshogs thams cad// chos kyi dbyings la bzhugs nas ni// de rnams bdag la dgongs su gsol// bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yang*// mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho dpal mchog gi /ji ltar nus pa'i nyer spyad kyis// dkyil 'khor bri bar bya'o kye/ slob ma rnams la brtse don dang*// khyed rnams la yang mchod phyir ro// rjes su brtse bar nyer dgongs la// nye ba nyid du mdzad pa'i rigs// zhes lan gsum du gsol ba btab nas/

dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo rnams la mchod pa byas nas/ rang gi snying kha ru bsdu bar bya'o// lha lhag par gnas pa'o// gsum pa bum pa lhag par gnas pa ni/ gser dngul dang rag zangs/ sa la byas pa yang rung ste/ gas chag dang zhom pa'i skyon med pa/ rgyud las gsungs pa'i tshad dang ldan pa la lha grangs dang mnyam pa'am/ shin tu bsdus pa la yang bco lnga bya ste/ rdza'i bum pa yin na dkar pos byugs te/ legs par bkrus nas/ sum bha ni'i sngags brjod la gu gul bdug cing*/ chu gtsang mas nang bkang*/ dar ram ras la sogs pa'i gtsang mas mgul chings bya/ byang chub kyi shing la sogs pas kha rgyan/ sa ha de ba dang*/ bh+ri ha ti dang*/ kan dha ka ri dang*/ dan dod pa ma dang*/ a sa dzi ta ste sman lnga dang*/ gro dang 'bras so ba dang til dang ma sha nas te 'bru lnga dang*/ gser dang dngul dang byu ru dang mu man dang mu tig ste rin po che lnga dang*/ bdud rtsi lnga la sogs pa bcud kyis bkang la/ gtso bo la pad ma dang nyi ma la gnas pa'i steng du rdo rje dang gri gug bskal pa bzang po rnams la pad ma dang zla ba'i steng du chos 'chad pa'i phyag rgya bris la dgod pa'i tshul ni/ rnam par rgyal ba dbus su bzhag /'khor lo bcu gnyis mtshams su'o// sangs rgyas bum pa nub kyi char// las kyi bum pa shar phyogs so// de nas me tog phreng ba dang bdud rtsis bkang ba'i dung chos bzhag la/ gzungs thag gis yongs su bskor te/ mchod pa rnams bshams nas/ bdag lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas/ rnam par rgyal ba'i bum pa mi dmigs pa las bam̐ dkar po yongs su gyur pa las/ rin po che'i bum pa'o// de'i nang du hri sna tshogs pa'i mdog can yongs su gyur pa las sna tshogs pad ma'o// de'i lte ba la nyi ma la cho ga gsum gyis lha thams cad bskyed de/ ye shes sems dpa' bstims la snyoms par zhugs pas/ chu'i ngo bor gyur pa la dri zhim po dang ldan pa me tog dang bcas pa'i dung steng du bzhag pa las chu cung zhig nang du blugs te gtso bo'i snying po stong phrag cig dang brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas so// lha thams cad kyi brgya rtsa brgyad rtsa brgyad kyang bzlas so// de yang rdo rje me tog gi phreng ba btags pa steng du bzhag nas so// de la mchod pa dang bstod pa dang bdud rtsi myang pa yang bya'o// bum pa lhag ma thams cad ming gi yi ge dang po las cho ga gsum gyis bskyed pa la sogs pa gong bzhin bya'o// las thams cad par ro langs gri gug bris te dum skyes ma bskyed la/

de'i sngags brgya rtsa brgyad sngags te/ mchod bstod dang bdud rtsi myang ba byas la phyi'i shar sgo'i nang du bzhag ste 'di brjod par bya'o// ji srid dkyil 'khor byas pa yis/ de srid bya ba ma rdzogs par// bcom ldan 'das ma khyod kyis ni// bdag gi bdug pa skrag par mdzod// ces brjod par bya'o// de nas dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgor gtor ma shin tu rgya chen po btang bar bya'o// bum pa lhag par gnas pa'i cho ga'o// bzhi pa slob ma lhag par gnas pa ni/ spro ba bskyed pa/ gsol ba gdab pa/ nyan par bskul ba lnga rnam par dag pa/ skyabs su 'gro ba/ sems bskyed pa/ lha bsgom zhing bsrung ba bya ba/ so shing sbyin/ skyor chu blud/ bsrung skud gdags/ ku sha'i sngas stan byin/ gsang sngags kyi dam tshig la dgod/ zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos bshad pa ste bcu gsum mo// dang po ni dang*/ dad pa dang ldan pa'i slob ma rnams/ las thams cad pa'i bum chus khrus byas te/ maṇ+ḍal gyi cho ga las byung ba bzhin maṇ+ḍal phul la/ me tog dang bcas pa'i thal mo sbyar ba slob ma mdun du 'dug pa la/ bla mas 'di skad brjod par bya'o// dal 'byor dang ldan pa'i mi lus rin po che thob/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'phrad par dka' ba dang mjal/ 'di lta bu sngon du bsod nams bsags pa'i 'bras bu yin pas/ da lta yang bstan pa'i sgor zhugs pa shin tu ngo mtshar che zhing*/ de las thun mong du ches khyad par 'phags pas/ rnal 'byor ma bla na med pa'i rgyud kyi dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur bar 'dod pa shin du ngo mtshar che ba yin te/ rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kun du spyod pa las/ dad pa yang dag bskyed pa dang*// rnal 'byor brtson pas gnas pa ni/ skye ba bye ba stong phrag tu// nga yis ye shes kyis bskul yin// zhes gsungs pas/ 'di lta bu'i dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa la/ 'jig rten 'di yi bya ba thams cad spangs nas/

phyi ma bla na med pa'i byang chub zhe thag pa nas thob par 'dod pas bsgrub pa'i bsam pa bya ste/ sngags kyi dngos grub don gnyer gang*// dkyil 'khor 'dir ni 'jug par bya// bsod nams 'dod pa de las gzhan// gzhan dag 'jig rten pha rol gnyer/ slar yang dad dang ldan pa yis// blo ldan dkyil 'khor 'jug par bya// tshe 'di'i 'bras bu don gnyer na// 'jig rten pha rol 'grub mi 'gyur// 'jig rten don mchog gnyer ba yis// 'jig rten pha rol la dmigs na// 'bad pa med par 'di 'bras 'grub// zhes gsungs pas/ bla na med pa'i byang chub don du gnyer ba'i sems rtse gcig pa'i sgo nas gsol ba gdab par bya'o// khyod ni ston pa dpal chen po// rdo rje phag mo bdag sbyor ba// mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo// byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa// de nyid dam tshig bdag la gsol// byang chub sems kyi bdag la gsol// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la gsol// thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu// mgon po bdag ni gzhug tu gsol// zhes lan gsum du gsol ba gdab bo// de nas slob ma mi dmigs par byas te/ cho ga gsum gyis gtso bo'i gzugs su bskyed de/ sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs la/ mdun du bzhag la 'di skad ces brjod par bya'o// bu tshur shog shig theg chen gyi// cho ga sngags kyi spyod pa'i tshul// khyod la yang dag bshad par bya// khyod ni tshul chen snod yin te// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang 'das dang*// de bzhin gang dag ma byon dang*// da ltar byung ba'i mgon po gang*// 'gro la phan phyir bzhugs pa ste// de dag kun gyi gsang sngags kyi// cho ga bzang po 'di mkhyen nas// dpa' bos byang chub shing drung du// thams cad mkhyen pa mtshan med brnyes// gsang sngags sbyor ba mnyam med de// skyob pa shākya seng ge yis// bdud sde shin tu mi zad pa// stobs chen dag kyang de yis bcom// 'jig rten rjes mthun rtogs nas ni// 'khor lo bskor nas mya ngan 'das// des na kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyir// bu yis blo gros 'di gyis shig

/rtog pa yang ni spangs nas su// bzang po brtson pa'i yid kyis nyon// ma lus brjod med blo gros la// rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs kyi// bde gshegs rnams kyis byin gyis rlobs// zhes spro bar nyan par bskul lo// lha rnam par dag pa bya ba ni/ bla ma dang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi drung du/ bdag cag tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa thams cad bshags pa bya/ de phyin chad mi byed pa'i dam bca'/ so so skye bo dang*/ nyan thos dang*/ rang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba la rjes su yid rang*/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul/ mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba gdab/ dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo bsam pa'i lad mo byed du bcug nas/ slob dpon bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid thog ma med par 'khor ba na sdig pa can gyi las bgyis pa dang bgyid du bstsal ba dang bgyid pa la rjes su yid rang ba de dag thams cad sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi mdun du so sor bshags par bgyi'o/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa dang pad ma dang las kyi rigs su bzhugs pa thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bya ba de bzhin gshegs pa dang rdo rje dang nor bu dang pad ma dang las kyi rigs su bzhugs pa thams cad dang snying po dang phyag dang gsang sngags dang rig pa'i lha thams cad kyi mdun du sdig pa thams cad bla na med pa'i bshags pas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis mkhyen bzhin du so sor bshags par bgyi'o// chos kyi dbyings ma lus pa dang mnyam par son pa'i bsod nams thams cad las rjes su yid rang ngo gang yang phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams su chos kyi 'khor lo mi bskor ba de rnams bla na med pa'i theg pa chen po'i chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor bar gsol ba gdab par bya'o// gang yang chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba rnams sems can gyi khams de srid du mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol bar bgyi'o// bdag gi dge ba'i las rnams 'di dag gis// 'jig rten du ni myur du sangs rgyas gyur// 'gro la phan phyir chos rnams ston bgyid cing*// sems can sdug bsngal mang pos gzir las dgrol// zhes brjod do// skyabs su 'gro ba ni/

dus 'di nas bzung nas ji srid bla na med pa'i byang chub sems can thams cad kyi skyabs gnas rang nyid kyis ma thob kyi bar du ched du bya ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du skyabs su 'gro ba'i bsams pa bya snyam pas/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dus 'di nas gzung ste/ ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sku gsum du rnam par bzhugs pa la skyabs su mchi'o// bla na med pa nges par 'byung ba chen po can gyi chos la skyabs su mchi'o// bla na med pa'i phyir mi ldog pa can gyi byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs la skyabs su mchi'o/ zhes lan gsum du brjod par bya'o// skyabs su 'gro ba'i bya ba dang bslab par bya ba'i phan yon rnams/ mdo rgyud las gsungs pa bzhin go bar bya'o// sems bskyed pa ni/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du/ bla na med pa'i byang chub smon pa dang 'jug pa'i sems bskyed de/ lam pha rol tu phyin pa drug la bslabs shing*/ byang chub chen po thob nas/ ma brgal ba rnams bsgral ba dang*// ma grol ba rnams grol ba dang*// dbugs ma phyin pa rnams dbugs dbyung ba dang*// yongs su mya ngan las ma 'da' ba rnams yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar bya ba'i bsam pas lad mo mdzod/ phyogs bcu dus gsum bzhugs pa yis/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*// rdo rje slob dpon dgongs su gsol// ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams// sems can rnams kyi don slad dus// byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed ltar// de bzhin bdag gi sems bskyed do// ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams// bsod nams ye shes byang chub lam// thabs dang shes rab goms pas bgrod// de bzhin bdag gis lam bsgrod do// ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams// thams cad mkhyen par sangs rgyas nas// mkha' mnyam sems can don mdzad ltar// de bzhin bdag gis don bgyi'o// ma sgral ba rnams bsgral ba dang*// ma grol ba rnams dgrol ba dang*// dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung zhing*// 'gro kun mya ngan 'das la dgod// kun kyang sangs rgyas thob par shog

/zhes lan gsum brjod la/ sems bskyed pa 'di ni sangs rgyas thob pa'i rgyur gyur pa/ bslab bya dang yon tan dpag tu med pa mdo dang rgyud rnams las gsungs pa thos pa byas nas bslab par bya'o// lha bsgom zhing bsrung ba bya ba ni/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad ma dang a las zla ba dang mam̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūm̐ las gyur pa'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ de yongs su gyur pa las/ slob ma rnams dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho rgyu'i he ru ka sku mdog sngon po zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis/ g.yas ser/ rgyab dmar/ g.yon ljang zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum ldan pa/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu/ gnyis kyi glang po che'i lpags pa/ g.yas kyi gsum pa na ḍa ma ru/ bzhi pa na dgra sta/ lnga pa na gri gug drug pa na rtse gsum bsnams pa/ g.yon gyi gsum pa na kha ṭ+wām̐ ka/ bzhi pa na thod khrag lnga pa ni rdo rje zhags pa/ drug pa na tshangs pa'i mgo bo 'dzin pa/ rus pa'i rgyan dang ldan par bsgoms la/ de'i spyi bor zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i steng oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par pad la gnas pa aḥdamar po/ snying khar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ sngon po mtshan pa bsgoms te/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs nas/ dri'i chus thig le gnas gsum du byas te/ skyes pa rnams la dpa' bo'i go cha/ bud med rnams la dpa' mo'i go cha bkod nas bsrung zhing*/ mchod pa rnam pa lnga yis mchod do// so shing sbyin pa ni/ dri zhim po'i shing la so shing sor bcu gnyis pa me tog gi phreng ba can byas te/ oṃ aḥhūm̐ zhes byin la ba glang gi lci ba la sogs pa'i so shing gi maṇ+ḍal gyi steng du/ oṃ badz+ra ha sa ha zhes bskyur la/ mi smra ba ni so shing bca'/ so shing mdun du drang por dor// dor zhing de bzhin mi bca' zhing*// phan tshun du yang mi dor ro// de ni rtse mo gyen bstan na// mchog gi dngos grub thob par 'gyur/

shar dang byang sogs kha bltas na// 'di ni dngos grub 'bring du bshad// gal te mtshams su bltas pa na// 'jig rten pa yi dngos grub thob// gal te thur du bltas na ni// sa 'og dngos grub thob par 'gyur// 'di la bskyar bar bya ba med// so shing ngo*// skyor chu blud pa ni/ oṃ khaṇa ḍa ro hi hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa ces sngags pa'i chus khyor bar byin la 'thung du gzhug ste/ oṃ bi shud dha dharma sarba pa pā ni tsa t+ya bi sho dha ya bi ka la pan a pa na ya hūm̐/ zhes 'thung du gzhug go /bsrung skud ni/ skud pa dmar po 'dom gang drug btab tu bsgril la/ oṃ aḥhūm̐ gis mdud pa gsum byas la/ skyes pa'i dpung pa g.yon/ bud med kyi g.yas su gdags la/ oṃ bud dha me tri rak+ṣa sarba na du swā hā zhes brjod cing byin la/ 'di ni bar chod kyi bgegs bsrung ba'o// de nas rtsa ku sha'i chun po che chung gnyis byas te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra tika sh+ṇa bam̐ byin gyis brlabs nas lag tu byin la/ gcig sngas su gcig mal stan du byin nas rmi lam brtag pa'i don du/ dam tshig sbyin pa ni/ rdo rje theg pa'i dkyil 'khor chen por 'jug pa la/ las dang po pa rnams kyi brtul zhugs 'di rnams yang dag par gzung bar bya'o// khyod kyis srog chags gsad mi bya// ma byin blang bar mi bya ste// 'dod log spyod pa mi bya zhing*// brdzun gyi tshig kyang smra mi bya// nyes pa kun gyi rtsa ba yi// chang gis myos par mi bya'o// bya ba ma yin thams cad spang*// sems can don la rgyab mi phyogs// legs pa yis ni nye bar gnas// rnal 'byor rnams la bsnyen bskur bya// lus kyi las ni rnam gsum dang*// ngag gi las ni rnam bzhi dang*// yid kyi rnam pa gsum dang ni// ngag gi las ni rnam bzhi dang*/ yid kyi rnam pa gsum dang ni// ji ltar nus pas rjes su bskyongs// theg pa dman la 'dod mi bya// 'khor ba yongs su mi spang zhing*// rtag tu myang 'das la mi dga'// gsang ba gsum gyi lha rnams la// brnyas pa nyid du mi bya'o// phyag rgya gzhon pa mtshon cha dang*// mtshan ma 'gong bar mi bya'o// dam tshig rab bsrungs bsod nams kyis// tshe 'di nyid la 'grub par 'gyur// zhes gsungs pas/

mi dge ba bcu'i las spangs pa dang*/ dge ba bcu'i las la brtson par bya ba dang*/ bslab pa bzhi lnga bsrung ba dang las dang po pa'i dam tshig rnams dang gzhan yang rigs lnga'i dam tshig dang*/ mchog gi dam tshig rjes su bstan pa rnams kyang ci nus kyis bslab par bya'o// da zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos bshad pa ni/ rnam par snang mdzad mngon par byang chub pa'i rgyud las byung ba/ 'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen dag /u dum 'bar ba'i me tog ltar// rgya lam na ni res 'ga' zhig /'byung 'gyur yang ni mi 'byung ngo*// gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul 'byung ba// de bas kyang ni dkon pa ste// gang gis sems can mnyam med don// mya ngan mi 'da' byed par nus/ bskal pa bye ba du ma ru// sdig pa byas par gyur pas kyang*// de kun dkyil 'khor 'di 'dra ba// mthong bas byang bar 'gyur yin na// grags pa mtha' yas sngags spyod pa'i// tshul la gnas na smos ci dgos// gang dag spyod pa mchog 'di la// blo gros shin tu mi g.yo ba// de dag gis ni ngan 'gro'i rgyun// sdug bsngal kun 'byung rab tu gcad// bdag nyid chen po khyed rnams kyis// rnyed pa mnyam med de ring rnyed// gang phyir rgyal ba sras bcas la// bdag nyid chen po kun gyis ni// bstan pa 'di la khyed rnams kun// yongs su bzung ste skye bzhin pas// de phyir khyed rnams theg chen la// sa ni rab tu skye bar 'gyur// theg pa chen po'i cher 'byung ba'i// lam mchog 'di ni dpal dang ldan// khyed rnams der ni dong bas na// de bzhin gshegs pa rnams su 'gyur// rang byung bskal pa chen po pa// 'jig rten kun gyi 'dren pa yi// yod dang med pa rnam par 'das// nam mkha' bzhin du dri ma med// zab mo rtog ge thams cad kyis// rab tu rtag med rnyog pa med// spros pa thams cad dang bral ba// spros pa rnams kyis ma spros pa/

bya dang las la sogs dang bral// bden pa gnyis la ma brten pa'i// ye shes mchog dang gtso bo 'di'i// tshul la gnas pa 'gyur ba yin// zhes brjod nas/ de rnams kyi don yang cung zad bshad par bya'o// lhag par gnas pa'i cho ga'o// dngos gzhi la gsum ste/ dkyil 'khor 'bri zhing bsgrub chos dang*/ rdo rje slob dpon 'jug pa'i cho ga dang*/ dbang bskur ba dngos so// dang po la thig gdab pa dang*/ bri ba dang*/ phyag mtshan dgod pa dang*/ gnas nye bar brgyan pa'i sgo nas bsgrub pa dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo nas dkyil 'khor bskyed nas mchog gi bsgrub pa dang*/ dkyil 'khor mchod pa'o// dang po ni gsum las/ thig skud byin gyis brlab pa ni/ dkar po la sogs kha dog lnga// btso bar byas la yang dag par// thig skud lnga ni bsgril bar bya// de yang dkyil 'khor nyis 'gyur la// sboms su sgo las nyi shur ni// gcig gis ma tshang tshad can no// skud pa kha dog lnga la rigs lnga'i sa bon swāhā dang bcas pas byin gyis brlabs nas/ ye shes lnga dgug cing*/ mig la dza dang ma'i yi ge bkod cing*/ oṃ di pa ta tri ṣam̐ ya a ku sha dza zhes/ lha rnams dgug cing gnyis su med par bsams la/ bsgril bar byas te/ oṃ a n+yo n+ya a nu ra ga ta sarba dharmaḥ oṃ s+pha ra s+pha ra a nu pra bi ṣ+ṭa sarba dharma: oṃ a d+yan ta a nu pra bi ṣ+ṭa aḥ sarba dharma zhes brjod nas/ bsgril nas oṃ hri ha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa kyis brtan bar byas te/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya hūm̐ tram̐ ma ti kra ma hūm̐/ zhes brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas nas/ mchod pas mchod de/ de nas ye shes kyi thig gdab pa ni/ slob dpon gyis he ru ka'i rnal 'byor dang*/ las byed pa khaṇa ḍa ro hi'i nga rgyal gyis/ rdo rje khu tshur gyis thig skud bzung ste/ oṃ dza dza zhes brjod nas/ shar nub tu gdab/ de bzhin du lho byang dang*/ me rlung gi mtshams dang*/ srin por dbang ldan du bskor te/

de nas ye shes kyi thig btab nas/ las kyi thig gdab par bya'o// 'dir smras pa/ 'khor lo rim pa bzhi po la// dang po thig ni bcu drug ste// gnyis pa sum cu so gnyis te// de las thig ni drug cu bzhi// dkyil 'khor gsum ni zlum po ste// phyi ma gru bzhi shes par bya// cha phran ni/ dang drug phyed gdab phyi ma gdab// gnyis bdun cha bzhir bgo byas te/ lnga brgyad dbus dor mtha' gnyis gdab// man ngag rim pa 'di nyid de// rgyud 'grel thig ni mang gsungs pa// spros pa can gyi don du'o// de ltar du thig btab nas/ tshon kha dog lnga la de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i sa bon bris nas/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus dang phyogs su bkod de/ de bzhin gshegs pa lnga bskyed nas dgug cing mchod pa lngas mchod nas/ 'di ni chos dbyings dag pa ste// mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho bla na med// dkyil 'khor chen po rmad byung ba// byin gyis brlab pa bla na med// oṃ badz+ra ram̐ ga sa ma ya oṃ aḥhūm̐/ khu tshur g.yon pas dbang ldan nas// ri mo rab tu dbab par bya// phyi nas ji ltar bde ba yis// dkyil 'khor nang nas slob rnams kyis// dkar po ljang khu dmar po dang*// ser po nag po de bzhin mchog /phyi la sogs nas mtshon rtsi rnams// ra ba rnams su rab tu grags// ji ltar phye ba de'i tshad las// sbom min phra ba min de bzhin// 'khyog min yongs su 'khor ba ni// mkhas pas ri mo dbab par bya// tshon 'gyed pa yi bya ba rnams// mngon rtogs rim pa las shes bya// zhes gsungs pas/ dbus su ni/ mthing ka dang ljang khu phyed ma la gnas pa rdo rje dang gri gug go /de'i phyi rol pad ma 'dab ma bzhi bcu zhe brgyad la/ mkha' 'gro ma nyi shu rtsa bzhi dang*/ bum pa la khas brgyan nyi shu rtsa bzhi spel bar bya'o// de'i phyi rol tu/ thugs gsung sku'i 'khor lo/ mthing dmar dkar gsum bcu po drug drug go

'khyams la ni bskal bzang sangs rgyas so// pan reg ni nag po dang sngon po gnyis so// phyi rol du dur khrod brgyad do// gnyis pa'i 'khor lo sngon po dang ljang khu dang ser po sum cu so drug drug go /re ga ni dkar dmar mthing nag gsum mo// 'khor lo gsum pa ni/ dmar po dang dkar po sna tshogs pa'i mdog can sum cu so drug drug go /bzhi pa'i sngon po dang dmar po dang dkar po sum bcu so drug drug go /re ga ni bzhi pa dang lnga ba'o// 'dod yon dmar/ pha gu ser/ dra phyed mthing*/ mda' yab dang pu shu sna tshogs pas rta babs ni mdzes mtshon/ dur khrod sum cu so gnyis la gzhi nag po la lha bkod do// 'khyams bzhi la/ bskal pa bzang po pa nyis brgya bzhi bcu zhe dgu dgu'o// lha so so'i gnas su phyag ma tshan dang thig le gang 'thad bkod do// phyi rol du pad ma/ rdo rje 'od kyi dra ba bya'o// tshon sna nyi shu rtsa lnga sogs pas mdzes par bris te/ rgyas par ni rgyud 'grel las gsungs pa bzhin du bri bar bya'o// de nas mchod pa'i tshogs thams cad nye bar brgyan te/ sngar bzhin du bum pa rnams kyang bkod nas/ me tog bdugs spos mar me dri// zhal zas rol mo ba dan dang*// gdugs dang rgyal mtshan la sogs pa// yang na lha grangs mnyam pa'am// ma 'byor brgya phrag re re ste// rin chen longs spyod sna tshogs kyis// dkyil 'khor nye bar brgyan par bya// bcom ldan 'das dang*/ mkha' 'gro dang*/ 'byung po'i gtor ma yang bsham par bya'o// de nas rdo rje slob dpon dang legs par bslabs pa'i slob ma rnams kyis/ bdag nyid kyi lha bsgom pa dang*/ lag pa'i mchod pa sngon du song nas/ nye reg dkyil 'khor du bsangs gtor byas te/ dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bskyed rims ltar bskyed nas/ sngar sta gon gyi lha nam mkha' la bteg pa dang*/ khams gsum thams cad kyi ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor spyan drangs pas dus cig gzhug par bya ste/

slar yang thig le dang phra mo'i rnal 'byor bzhin du bde ba chen po ro mnyam par byas la/ chu bzhi dang*/ rig ma bcu drug dang*/ rgyal srid rin po che bdun dang*/ gā+o ri la sogs pa lha mo brgyad dang*/ rdo rje rnam pa gsum gyi mchod pas mchod de/ rkang pa bzhi bcu zhe brgyad pa dang*/ dan dha ka la sogs pa bstod pa rnams kyis bstod nas/ brtan par bya ba ni/ dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa'i rim pa ste/ rang nyid lha bsgom sngon du song bas/ gar shes bud med rnam ldan pas// glu dang sgra la sogs kun gyis// sangs rgyas zhing du rnam gnas pa// sangs rgyas kun dang 'khor thams cad// nam mkha'i phyogs su bzhugs rnams dang*// dkyil 'khor pa rnams legs mchod de// 'di ltar bskul zhing spyan drangs bya// phyogs rnams kun nas bzhugs pa yi// sangs rgyas bdag la dgongs su gsol// rdo rje bdag ming che ge mo// dkyil 'khor bdag gis bstan par bya// de phyir sangs rgyas kun gshegs la// deng bdag dngos grub bstsal du gsol// dkyil 'khor bsgrub cing mchod pa'i cho ga'o// de nas rdo rje slob dpon rang nyid 'jug pa'i don/ bdud rtsi lngas sbyar ba'i gtor ma la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nye bar sbyangs pas/ 'byung po'i tshogs la byin nas/ ngag tu brjod pa ni/ gang du bcom ldan 'das lhan cig 'ongs pa'i phyogs kyis bdag po rnams/ gang yang rjes su 'brangs bcas 'dir// gnas pa de dag thams cad rnams/ bdag ni rjes su gzung ba'i phyir// ji ltar rig par gyur pa 'di// dri dang me tog gtor ma sogs// bzhes te sems can kun la yang*// byams pa'i sems dang slob ma la// bgegs med pa ni mdzad du gsol// las kyi bum pa'i chus khrus byas nas/ ji srid du 'og tu 'chad pa ltar dbang gi cho ga rjes su gnang ba dang bcas pa/ yi dam gyi lha la/ rang nyid kyis dbang gi cho ga rgyas bsdus ci rigs kyis blang bar bya'o// de nas dkyil 'khor du me tog gi phreng ba phul la/

sngags de nyid kyis mgo bos bcings te/ 'dod chags chen po bde ba che// rdo rje chen po nor chen po// rdo rje sems dpa' bdag 'grub 'gyur// oṃ pa ra ma su kha a sha ya a la li ta bi la a pa na mi te a ri na mā mi bha ga wan aḥkham̐ bī ra hūm̐/ pra ti tsa ku ru ma ra dza miṃ nā tha hoḥ de nas bden pa'i tshig brjod par bya ste/ nam mkha' las ni skyes pa'i phyir// thog ma tha ma med pa'i mchog /dam tshig sems dpa' rdo rje che// rdo rje sems dpa' deng bdag 'grub// dngos grub chen po kun gyi mchog /dbang phyug chen po lhag pa'i lha// rdo rje 'chang ba kun gyi rgyal// mi 'gyur mchog tu bdag 'grub 'gyur// nyes pa mi mnga' brtag pa ni// 'dod chags kun gyi rjes chags pa/ 'dod chags chen po dga' ba che// bcom ldan de nyid grub par mdzod// shin tu dag pa kun gyi mchog /gdod nas grol ba de bzhin gshegs// kun du bzang po kun bdag nyid// byang chub sems la bdag 'grub shog /dngos grub chen po kun gyi mchog /dbang phyug che mchog phyag rgyar ldan// grub pa'i rdo rje cher bstod pa// rdo rje snyems bdag phyag 'tshal lo// he ru ka dpal slob dpon che// sangs rgyas byang chub sems kun gyis// gsungs pa'i cho ga dag gis ni// phun sum tshogs pa'i cho ga yis// sems can don ni bdag gis bgyi// de la rjes gnang btsal mdzod la// sangs rgyas byang chub sems rnams kyis// bdag la nye bar mdzad du gsol// sems can kun gyi yid khyab pa// sems can kun gyi yid la gnas// sems can kun gyi yab kyang nyid// dam tshig mchog rnams kyi sku mchog /byung dang 'byung bar 'gyur ba yi/ de bzhin gshegs rnams khyed kyis bsgrubs// bden pa 'di yis bdag mgon po// 'dod pa khyod kyis rdzogs par mdzod// bden pa'i byin gyis brlabs phyi nas// blo dang lda pas 'di mchod bya// chos kyi dbyings kyi byin brlabs dang*// dam tshig kyang ni dran pa yis// brtse bas sems can kun gyi don// dngos grub kun phyir mdzad du gsol// zhes brjod par bya'o// rdo rje slob dpon 'jug pa'i cho ga'o// dbang bskur ba dngos la drug ste/

dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa dang*/ bum pa'i dbang dang gsang dbang dang*/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang dang*/ bzhi pa dang*/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang rjes gnang dang bcas pa'o// dang po la/ khrus bya/ maṇ+ḍal dbul/ gdong bcing*/ phyag rgya/ 'jug pa'i gsol ba gdab pa/ dam tshig byin/ lhar bskyed/ sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab/ rdo rje rnal 'byor du sems bskyed gsang ba'i dam tshig la bzhag ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor du gzhug rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa ste bcu gnyis so// dang po ni las thams cad pa'i bum pas khrus bya'o// gnyis pa gser la sogs pa'i maṇ+ḍal phul bar bya'o// gsum pa gdong bcing ba la/ dar ram ras dmar po la dum skyes ma'i sngags sam yang na ni hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags kyis bsang nas byin la/ oṃ badz+ra u ṣ+ṇi sha hūm̐ zhes brjod la gdong bcing ngo*/ oṃ suṃ bha ni hūm̐ zhes stod g.yogs sbyin no// bzhi pa phyag bya ba ni/ bla ma dang dkyil gyi lha tshogs gsal ba'i shar phyogs nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pu dzo s+tha nā ya ad ma nam̐ ni d+ya ta ya mi sarba ta tha ga ta a k+ṣo bh+ya a dhi tiṣ+ṭha swa mam̐/ nub phyogs nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pu dza pra ma ta nā ya ad ma naṃ ni d+ya ta ya mi sarba ta thā ga ta a mi ta bhaṃ pra bar ta yā mi/ byang phyogs nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pu dza karma ṇe ad ma naṃ ni d+ya ta yā mi sarba ta ad mo gha sid dhi ku ru maṃ/ zhes phyag 'tshal nas/ lnga pa gsol ba gdab pa ni/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku// bla ma la ni skyabs su mchi// bdag ming 'di zhes bya ba yis// byang chub sems ni yongs bzung dang*// gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir 'jug cing*// dam tshig sdom pa nod par 'tshal// de nyid slob dpon 'phrin las dang*// sdom pa gsang mchog bshad du gsol// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// bdag ni rtag tu slob dpon gyur// zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab la/

yang slob dpon gyis/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor che// gsang ba chen po'i rigs dge ba// gsang chen yongs su bzung ba ru// bdag nyid chen po khyod 'dod dam// yang slob mas lan du/ dam tshig de nyid bdag la gsol// sdom pa yang ni bdag la gsol// rdo rje'i rigs kun bsdus pa la// slob dpon chen po bdag gzhug mdzod// phyir mi ldog pa'i dbang bskur ba'i/ bskal pa chen po bdag la rtsol// dus gsum bzhugs rnams sangs rgyas kyi// sangs rgyas byang chub go 'phang mchog /slob dpon chen po bdag la gsol// mtshan nyid dang ni dpe byad dang*// nam mkha'i 'od gsal yang dag ldan// sangs rgyas sku ni yid 'ong ba// mgon po chen po bdag la gsol// dbang bskur ba ni rmad byung che// sems can kun gyi don brtson pas// rtag tu bdag ni slob dpon gyur// zhes gsol ba gdab bo// drug pa dam tshig sbyin pa la gsum ste/ dam tshig byin pa'i don du dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa dang*/ dam tshig bsgrags pa dang*/ bzung ba'o// dang po ni slob dpon gyis/ dkyil 'khor du/ 'di lta bu'i gsol ba gdab ste/ bdag ming che ge zhes bya ba'i// rdo rje slob dpon dka' thub che// sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir// slob ma rnams ni gzhug par bya// dkyil 'khor snying po 'di nyid du// rdo rje'i ye shes thob bya'i phyir// de bzhin gshegs kun grong khyer du// bdag ni slob ma gzhug par bya// āḥkham̐ bhi ra hūm̐ zhes brjod nas gral la 'khod do// de nas dkyil 'khor du zhugs pas lhag par mos par byas te/ rigs rnam pa lnga'i dam tshig bsgrag pa ni/ khyed rnams rdo rje'i theg pa dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor du 'jug par byed pa la/ de bzhin rnam par snang mdzad kyi dam tshig ni/ dkon mchog gsum dang*/ byang chub tu sems bskyed pa/ sdom pa'i tshul khrims/ dge ba chos bsdud/

sems can gyi don byed kyi tshul khrims rnams bzung dgos te/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// rin chen gsum gyi dam tshig bsten// de ltar sangs rgyas rigs dag gi /sdom pa brtan pa 'gyur ba'o// zhes gsungs so// de bzhin du mi bskyod pa'i dam tshig ni/ phyi'i rdzas kyi rdo rje dril bu dang*/ nang rtsa rlung dang*/ de kho na bde stong shes rab kyi dam tshig bzung zhing*// bla ma la sangs rgyas ltar bltas te/ rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya dag /blo gros chen po khyod kyis zung*// byang chub sems gang deng rdo rje// shes rab dril bu zhes bshad do// slob dpon dag kyang bzung bar bgyi/ bla ma sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam// 'di ni rdo rje rigs dag pa'i// dam tshig sdom pa yin par gsungs// rin chen 'byung ldan gyi dam tshig dang sdom pa ni/ longs spyod sbyin pa dang*/ chos sbyin pa dang*/ skyabs sbyin pa dang*/ byams pa chen po'i sbyin pa rgyun mi chad par bya ba ste/ rin chen rigs mchog chen po la// nyin dang mtshan mo lan gsum du// zang zing mi 'jigs chos dang byams// sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag sbyin bya// zhes gsungs so// 'od dpag med kyi dam tshig dang sdom pa ni/ phyi nyan thos kyi theg pa/ nang pha rol tu phyin pa gsang ba rdo rje theg pa rnams bzung bar bya ste// 'di ni pad ma'i rigs dag pa'i// dam tshig sdom pa mchog yin te// phyi nang gsang ba'i theg pa gsum// khyod kyis dam pa'i chos bzung bya// zhes gsungs so// don yod grub pa'i las kyi rigs kyi dam tshig ni/ mchod pa/ bstod pa dang*/ bza' ba dang*/ btung ba la sogs spyod lam gyi dam tshig ma nyams par bzung bar bya ste/ las kyi rigs mchog chen po la// sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni// rang nyid de nyid so sor bzung*// mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus gyis/ zhes gsungs so// 'di dag dang mchog gi dam tshig gzhan yang*/

dbang gong ma dang rjes su mthun par spyad par bya ba 'di dag ma nyams par bzung na/ tshe gcig gis rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang thob par gsungs shing thams cad bsgrub mi nus pa rnams kyis ci nus kyis khas blangs par bsams la lad mo gyis/ mgon po sangs rgyas rnams dang ni// sras bcas bdag la dgongs su gsol// bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yi/ dus 'di nas ni rab bzung ste// byang chub snying po mchis kyi bar// ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams// byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i// byang chub sems ni bla med pa// dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi/ sangs rgyas rnal 'byor sdom pa la// tshul khrims kyis ni bslab pa la// dge ba'i chos ni bsdus pa dang*/ sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum/ bdag gi brtan por bzung bar bgyi// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum// deng nas brtsams te bzung bar bgyi// nam du yang ni mi spang ngo*// rdo rje'i rigs mchog chen po yi// rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya dag /yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi// slob dpon dag kyang bzung bar bgyid// rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi// dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la// nyin re bzhin du dus drug tu// sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin// byang chub chen po las byung pa'i// pad ma'i rigs mchog dag pa la// phyi nang gsang ba'i theg pa gsum// dam pa'i chos ni bzur bar bgyi// las kyi rigs mchog chen po la// sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni// yang dag nyid du bzung bgyi zhing*// mchod pa'i las ni ci nus bgyi// byang chub sems ni bla na med// dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyi zhing*// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// bdag gis sdom pa ma lus bzung*// ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol// ma bsgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgral// dbugs ma phyin pa rnams dbyung zhing*// sems can mya ngan 'das la dgod// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta yo ga kā ya wa tsīta ta mud pa ta ya me she ṣā na ba she ṣā sa ta d+dha tu hi ta su khod ta ma sid dhi a d+yan dha bha bā sid ti ma te shwa t+ya a dhi pata d+ya tsa ya/

zhes dam tshig dbog par bya'o// bdun pa lha bskyed pa ni/ slob ma rnams skad cig gis pad ma dang nyi ma'i steng du dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho sta gon gyi skabs ltar bskyed do// brgyad pa sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab pa ni spyi bor zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i steng du/ oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par pad ma la gnas pa'i steng du ā dmar po/ snying khar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi hūm̐ sngon po mtshan pa bsgoms te/ oṃ sarba bi ra yo gi ni ka ya wa ka tsi ta badz+ra sa bha ba ad ma ko ham̐/ zhes gnas gsum du dri'i chus thig le byas te/ byin gyis brlab bo/ dgu pa rdo rje rnal 'byor du sems bskyed par bya ste/ rang nyid lhar bsgoms pa'i snying khar kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi ngo bo zla ba nya gang ba'i steng du/ don dam pa byang chub kyi sems kyi ngo bo rdo rje sngon po rtse mo lnga pa lte ba hūm̐ gis mtshan pa bsgom du bcug nas/ snying khar rdo rje bzung la/ su ra te sa ma ya stam̐ ho/ sid dh+ya badz+ra ya thā su kham̐/ rdo rje rnal 'byor du sems bskyed par bya'o// bcu pa dam tshig bsgrag pa ni/ yi dam lha'i dam tshig phan yon bsgrag pa dang*/ nyes dmigs kyi sgo nas dam tshig bsgrag pa dang*/ dam tshig gi chu byin pa dang rdo rje slob dpon gyi dam tshig rim pa bsgrags pa las/ dang po spyi bor rdo rje bzhag la/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs su zhugs kyis ngas khyod la rdo rje'i ye shes bskyed par bya'o// ye shes gang gis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dngos grub kyang thob par 'gyur na/ dngos grub gzhan lta smos kyang ci dgos/ khyod kyis dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba rnams la brjod par ma byed cig /dam tshig nyams par gyur te re/ 'di ni dam tshig rdo rje ste// gal te la lar khyod 'di smra// khyod kyi spyi bo 'gas par byed// rdo rje snying khar bzhag la// rdo rje sems dpa' rang nyid ni// khyod kyi snying la yang dag zhugs// gal te tshul 'di smras na ni// de ma thag tu dral te gshegs// zhes pa dang*/

bdud rtsi'i chu blud pa ni/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu// dam tshig 'das na bsreg par byed// dam tshig bsrungs ni dngos grub ni// rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'thung shig /rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya ni// dkyil 'khor med la gal te smra// skye bo tshogs pa'i nang gnas nas// ma dad bzhad gad kyis ma yin/ badz+ra ud ta kam̐ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes dam tshig gi chu 'thung du gzhug go /rdo rje slob dpon gyi dam tshig bsgrag pa ni/ deng tshun chad khyod kyi dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho nga yin gyis/ ngas 'di gang gyis shig ces bsgo ba khyod kyis bya dgos so// khyod kyis nga la brnyas par ma byed cig ya nga ba ma spangs par tshe'i dus byas nas/ dmyal bar ltung bar gyur ta re/ zhes gsang ba'i dam tshig brjod do// bcu gcig pa ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa ni/ ting nge 'dzin bsgom pa dang gsol ba gdab pa dang*/ brtan par bya ba las/ dang po zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa'am/ yang na zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i lha'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pas/ snying khar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ bam̐/ de las 'od zer 'phros nas dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i lha dang*/ khams gsum pa thams cad kyi gnas sum cu so drug gi dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i 'od zer dmar po'i tshul du bsdus nas/ snying kha'i sa bon la thim nas lus sems thams cad bde ba chen po'i ngo bor gyur par bsam/ gsol ba gdab pa ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis rlobs la dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho bdag la stsal tu gsol/ 'di ni dam tshig rdo rje ste// mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho zhes byar grags// ye shes rdo rje bla med pa// de ring bdag la dbab tu gsol// zhes lan gsum du gsol ba btab nas/ dkyil dkrung phyed pa'i 'dug stangs dang*/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dpral bar byas te/ gu gul nag po dang*/

byi la nag po'i brun dang si la ka dang bcas pa spo sa kyis bdugs shing*/ sngags 'dis rol mo'i sgra dang bcas pa ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor bskul bar bya ste/ oṃ ti kra ma hā kro ta a be sha ya/ shri badz+ra he ru ka badz+ra ḍa ki/ a a aḥ ra ra ra/ tsa la ya tsa la ya// hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa zhes dbab par bya'o// 'di yi sku bab pa ni sku'i bya ba byed do// gsung babs pa'i rtags ni ngag smra ba dang gsung gi dbang phyug tu 'gyur ro// thugs babs pa'i rtags ni ting nge 'dzin dang mngon par shes pa 'char bar 'gyur ro// ring du 'phar na lce a aḥdamar po bsgoms nas smros shig ces brjod na/ dge ba dang mi dge ba smra bar 'gyur ro// de nas brtan par bya ba ni/ bdud rtsi'i chus rlan pa'i rdo rje spyi bor bzhag la/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra tri dho me bha ba/ sha shā to me bha ba hri da ya me a dhi ti ṣ+ṭha sarba sid dha dham̐ me pra yats+tsha sarba karma su tsa me tsi ta shri yam̐/ ku ru hūm̐ ha ha ha ha hoḥ zhes brtan par bya'o// ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i cho ga'o// bcu gnyis pa rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa la/ me tog dor ba/ mig 'byed pa/ snang ba brtags pa/ dkyil 'khor bstan pa bzhi las/ dang po me tog dor ba ni/ slob mas dkyil 'khor gyi lha rang gi lhag pa'i lha la dmigs te/ me tog gi phreng ba thal mo sbyar ba'i bar du bzung nas/ bla mas bden pa'i tshig brjod pa ni/ dkyil 'khor 'di ru yang dag par/ bdag gis slob ma bcug pa la// ji ltar bsod nams de bzhin shog /lha rnams kun gyi rigs kyi rim// gang gi rigs kyi snod yin pas// gang 'dra 'di yi dngos grub 'gyur// gang 'dra'i bsod nams rjes mthun pa'i// de 'dra'i dkyil 'khor 'dir gyur cig /oṃ pra tits+tsha badz+ra ho/ zhes brjod cing dor du bcug la/ slar yang pra bhi sh+ya ku lam̐ ma hā ba lam̐ zhes bya ba'i sngags kyis phreng ba de blangs la/

lha rnams kyi gnas shes par byas nas me tog gang la phog pa'i lha de bstim par bya'o// de nas mig dbye ba ni/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro deng khyod kyi// mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzod// phye bas thams cad mthong bar 'gyur// rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med// oṃ badz+ra ḍā kār na swa yan te d+ya/ tsa k+ṣu rud pa ḍa na tata pa ra/ u pa ḍa ya ti sarba k+ṣo/ badz+ra tsak+ṣu ra a nud ta raḥ zhes mig dbye'o// snang ba brtag pa ni/ slob dpon gyis bden pa'i tshig brjod pa ni/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste// dag cing gsal la rnyog pa med// gzung du med cing brjod du med// rgyu dang las las kun du skyes// bden pa 'di yis dkyil 'khor du// gzugs brnyan lta bur slob ma ni// gsal zhing sdig med mthong bar shog /ces dang*/ khyod kyi mig gis ci mthong gyur// ji ltar bde ba nges par smros// zhes brjod cing*/ dkar por mthong na zhi ba/ ser por mthong na rgyas pa/ dbang la dmar po/ nag po la drag po/ sna tshogs pa la 'phrin las sna tshogs 'grub par bshad do// de nas dkyil 'khor bstan par bya ba ni/ da ni dad pa rab tu bskyed// dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos// sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs// sangs rgyas rnams kyi rigs su bskyed// mthong bas dngos grub thams cad 'ong*// phun sum tshogs pa mngon du 'gyur// dam tshig bsrungs ba dngos grub ste// khyod kyis sngags rnams brtson par bya// ji ltar bsod nams dag stobs las// dkyil 'khor mthong ba de nas ni// sna tshogs 'od zer 'phro ba yi// dkyil 'khor mthong bar the tshom med// de nas he ru ka la sogs pa'i gnas dkyil 'khor bstan par bya ste/ gang zhig shri gang bla med pa'i// rgyu nyid kyang ni med pa yin// brjod dngos med las de rnams sku// dpal he ru ka zhes byar dran// rdo rje ye shes dbyer med phyir// rtag tu sdig pa las sgrib dang*/

'dod chags dman pa'i sbyor ba gang*// rdo rje sngon po can phag mo// mchog tu 'gro ba'i ngang tshul phyir// mkha' 'gro ma zhes rab tu grags// de'i rigs lnga po'ang de 'dra'o// gang zhig rtag tu gdug za bas/ lā mar zhes byar de bzhin dran// de'i rigs lnga po yang de dang 'dra// de bzhin shes bya gzhan gnyis kyi ngang*/ dum bur byed cing bskyed pas kyang*// dum skyes ma zhes bya bar brjod// sna tshogs pa yi gzugs 'dzin phyir/ gzugs can ma zhes rab tu bshad// gzhan yang btso ma'i rnam dag pa// bdun cu rtsa gnyis phyag rnams ni// rgyu dag par ni brjod par bya// phyag bzhi rgod pa la sogs pa// bzhi po rnams ni dag par 'dod/ zhal rnams dag pa'i dngos po ni// lhan skyes rdzogs byang chub bcu drug /bcu bdun pa'i zhal yid du bshad// srid dang mya ngan 'das zhabs gnyis// thams cad rgyan gyi dag pa ni// chos dang chos pa'i skyes rnams so/ lhag ma lha rnams thams cad kyi// so so brjod par mi nus par// 'khor lo bcu gnyis dag pa dang*// gnas bcu gnyis dang sa bcu gnyis// rdo rje 'chang ba sgor gnas rnams// de rnams dag pa'i ngo bo yin// ye shes chos dang longs spyod rdzogs// sprul pa dag pas dkyil 'khor bzhi// yid kyi dkyil 'khor mchog yin pa// gang phyir dkyil 'khor yang dag bshad// ye shes chos dang longs spyod rdzogs// kun nas kun du mnyam pa'i phyir// zlum po'i dkyil 'khor gsum yin no// sprul pa kun du 'phrul rgyas pas// dkyil 'khor bzhi pa grub bzhi pa// yang na mtha' bzhi gcod phyir ro// rlung gnyis dbu mar 'dus pa dang*// sku gsum dang ni dga' ba bzhi// ye shes lnga rnams dag pa ni// dkyil 'khor bzhi brtseg la rim sbyar// bzhi po kun gyi thun mong gi /rnam dag rgyas par gsungs bshad bya// byin gyis brlabs pa 'i thig yin phyir/ mnyam med tshad med pa las so// tshul khrims sdom pa bla med pa// rgyan gang yin par yang dag bshad// dad pa'i dbang po sogs can sems// rtsig pa lnga ru byung ba yin// rnam par thar pa rnam pa bzhi// gang zhig sgor ni yang dag bshad// yang dag rab tu spong ba bzhi// rta babs kyis ni ka bar byung*// dran pa'i ye shes bzhi rnams ni// kha khyer bzhi ru dran par bya// rdzu 'phrul gyi ni rkang pa bzhi// sgo khyud rnam pa bzhi yin no// byang chub yan lag bdun phreng ba// ba dan me tog phreng bar brjod// rnam kun mkhyen nyid ye shes ni/

ting 'dzin gnyis su bstan pa yin/ lam gyi ye shes khyad par ni// rnga yab tu ni brjod pa yin// nyon mongs thams cad zad byed pas// de bzhin drwa ba zhes brjod do// yang dag gcod pa'i rab 'phrog dang*// rnam par sel ba'i rab 'phrog pa// chos gnyis kyis ni sbyor bas te// nyon mongs rnams kyi phyed 'phrog phyir// drwa ba phyed pa zhes brjod do// sangs rgyas kun gyi nyams chen rnams// dus thams cad du ka bar byung ba// 'phags pa'i lam gyi yan lag brgyad/ ka ba brgyad ces bya bar dran// de yi dbus kyi pad ma'i nang*// skyon gyis ma gos par ston no// 'khor lo bcu gnyis bshad pa rnams// sa yi mi mthun phyogs spong ba'o// yang dag bshad pa'i rtsibs 'di rnams/ nyon mongs nye ba'i nyon mongs sel// rdo rje la sogs phreng ba gang*// glo bur ba yi dri ma sel// cha shas bcu drug rnams kyi bar// dur khrod dag par shes par bya// dkyil 'khor dag pa thams cad kyang*/ chos dus ston pa po yin no// lhag ma 'jig rten khams kyi ni/ rnam dag gsal dang mi gsal ba'o// sangs rgyas yon tan de dag kun// dkyil 'khor du ni brjod pa yin// sems can kun don brtson rnams kyis/ rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis de nyid bstan// zhes dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bstan cing*/ rgyas par ni mngon rtogs bzhin du bstan par bya'o// rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'o// gnyis pa bum pa'i dbang las gsol ba gdab pa dang*/ mi bskyod pa'i chu'i dbang dang*/ cod pan dang*/ rdo rje dang*/ dril bu dang*/ ming dang*/ brtul zhugs rnam pa gnyis dang bdun las dang po gser la sogs pa'i maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ gsol ba gdab pa ni/ dpal ldan mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho yi// 'khor lo bcu gnyis dbang bskur ba// mi bskyod rdo rje chu yi dbang*// deng 'dir bdag la stsal du gsol// de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis// yon tan 'byung gnas bdag nyid che// dpa' bo chen po mi ldog pa'i/

dbang bskur ba ni bdag la stsol// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// rtag tu bdag ni slob dpon gyur// zhes lan gsum du gsol ba gdab bo// de nas bum pa thams cad kyi chu/ rnam par rgyal bar bsdus la/ slob ma rnams kyi mgo thog tu bzhag pa ting nge 'dzin ni/ slob ma rnams kyang dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pas/ snying kha'i 'od zer gyis phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa dang*/ 'khor lo bcu gnyis kyi 'khor lo'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i thugs ka nas byung ba/ rin po che'i bum pa thogs pa'i lha mo rnams kyis spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ rnam par shes pa'i phung po dang nyon mongs pa zhe sdang dag me long lta bu'i ye shes kyi he ru kar gyur par bsam zhing*/ de dang dus gcig tu pi wang ma la sogs pa'i mchod pas mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis dbang gis dgongs par mdzad/ khwa gdong ma la sogs pa yis bgegs bsrung bar bsams nas/ rol mo'i sgra dang bcas pas/ gsang gsum dam tshig las byung ba// ye shes bdud rtsi bla na med// lha yi chu ni dag pa yi// mi bskyod pa yis dbang bskur ro// oṃ shri badz+ra he ru ka hūm̐/ ḍā ki ni dz+wa la sam̐ bha ra a bhi shin tsa tu mam̐/ badz+ra ka la a bhi she ka to sa ma ya shrī hūm̐/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// de bzhin gshegs kun khrus gsol ba// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis khrus bgyi'o// zhes pa dang*/ bkra shis kyi tshig rnams brjod nas khrus bya'o// mi bskyod pa'i chu'i dbang ngo*// rin chen 'byung ldan gyi cod pan gyi dbang ni/ rin po che'i dbu rgyan dang dar dpyangs la/ rin chen 'byung ldan rin chen mkha' 'gro'i byin gyis brlabs pa/ slob ma rad na he ru ka mos pa byas pa'i spyi bor bcings te/ tshor ba'i phung po dang nyon mongs pa nga rgyal dang ser sna dag nas/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes brtan par gyur par ltas te/

sangs rgyas kun gyi rgyal srid che// dbu rgyan rin chen bla na med// rin chen 'byung ldan mchog 'gro ba// rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis dbang bskur ro// thor tshugs cod pan gyis brgyan pa// sangs rgyas kun gyis bsngags pa yi// rin chen dag gi dbu rgyan dang*// dar dpyangs cod pan sbyin par bya/ oṃ rad na mu ku ṭa tam̐ a bhi ṣin tsa tu mam̐/ sarba bud dha ḍa ki ni ye a bhi she ka ta sa ma ya shri hūm̐/ zhes sbyin par bya'o// dbu rgyan dang dar dpyangs cod pan gyi dbang ngo*// 'od dpag tu med pa rdo rje'i dbang ni/ rdo rje dang oṃ las 'od dpag tu med pa dang*/ hri las byung ba'i pad ma mkha' 'gro ma'i byin gyis brlabs pa/ slob ma pad+ma he ru ka bskyed pa'i lag pa g.yas pa la byin te/ 'du shes kyi phung po dang nyon mongs pa 'dod chags dag nas/ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes kyi rang bzhin du gyur par bltas la/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi rdo rje'i dbang*// mi phyed rdo rje 'od gsal bas// dam chos 'byung ba'i sgor gyur pa'i// 'od dpag med kyis dbang bskur ro// dam tshig rdo rje chen po'i dbang*// sangs rgyas rnams kyis rab bsgrub pa/ mi 'gyur skur ni bsgrub pa yi// rdo rje'i dbang bskur sbyin par bya// oṃ pad ma ka la k+ṣa a bhi ṣin tsa aṃ badz+ra pad ma ḍa ki ni ye a bhe ka to sa ma ya shri hūm̐/ zhes rdo rje'i dbang sbyin no// don yod grub pa dril bu'i dbang ni/ dril bu khaṃ las don yod grub pa dang*/ kar ma ḍa ki'i rang bzhin du byin gyis brlabs pas/ slob ma kar ma he ru ka gsal bar bltas la/ lag pa g.yon pa la byin te/ sangs rgyas kun gyi dril bu'i dbang*// dam chos 'byung ba'i sgor gyur cing*// mchod pa'i las kun rdzogs byed pa// rdo rje'i las kyis dbang bskur ro// 'di ni rnal 'byor ma kun gyi// shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gror bshad// khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang*// byang chub mchog tu rgyal ba bzhed// oṃ a mo gha sidhi ha ka la sha a bhi ṣin tsa hūm̐/

a dhi pa ti tam̐ a bhi she ka ta sa ma ya shri hūm̐/ zhes dril bu'i dbang bskur ro// rnam par snang mdzad ming gi dbang ni/ rdo rje dang dril bu rnam par snang mdzad dang*/ rdo rje phag mo'i byin gyis brlabs pa/ slob ma la gtad nas/ 'khyud pa'i tshul du byas te/ rnam par snang mdzad he ru ka'i rang bzhin mos par byas la/ lha'i rnga bo che'i sgra skad lta bur ming gi dbang bskur bas/ ming dang gzugs kyi phung po dang nyon mongs pa gti mug sbyangs nas/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes su rang bzhin du gsal bar mos te/ rdo rje ming gi dbang bskur bas// byang chub snying po'i bar du ni// ces kyang mi chod mi phyed pas// rdo rje'i ming du rab tu grags// rdo rje dril bu yang dag 'khyud// g.yon bsnyems ma dang sgros 'dzin ma// gnyis med gnyis min rnal 'byor bdag /phyag rgya chen pos byin gyis brlabs// oṃ bhud dha ka la a bhi shiñtsa oṃ/ badz+ra bhai ro tsa na ye na ma a bhi she ka ta/ kye dpal rol pa'i rdo rje/ bde ba'i rdo rje/ a la la'i rdo rje/ zhes bya bas snying po'i ming ngo*// mi bskyod rdo rje/ zhe sdang rdo rje/ thugs kyi 'khor lo bzhi'i ming ngo*// 'dod chags rdo rje/ 'od dpag med rdo rje/ gsung gi 'khor lo bzhi'i ming ngo*// rnam par snang mdzad rdo rje/ gti mug rdo rje/ sku'i 'khor lo bzhi'i ming ngo*// rin chen rdo rje/ ser sna rdo rje/ rnal 'byor ma nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i ming ngo*// don yod rdo rje/ phrag dog rdo rje/ sgo mtshams ma sum cu so gnyis kyi ming ngo*// rdo rje las/ rdo rje rgyu zhes pa ni dur khrod sum cu so gnyis kyi'o// ming gi dbang bskur ba'i cho ga'o// brtul zhugs rnam pa gnyis las/ dang po rigs drug pa dpal he ru ka mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pas/ kha ṭ+wām̐ kha dang*/ ḍa ma ru dang*/ gri gug dang*/

thod pa rnams lag tu byin la/ rang nyid dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i sbyor bas/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can gyi don gyis shig /he ru ka dpal kha ṭ+wām̐ ga /rnal 'byor ma ni ḍa ma ru// rdo rje kha ṭ+wām̐ rdo rje bcas/ dril bu sil sil sgra sgrogs pa// tshangs pa'i skud thogs rnal 'byor bdag /gri gug dang ni ka pa la// dpa' bo chen pos blang bar gyis// 'di ltar he ru ka'i brtul zhugs thob nas/ rgyud lta ba dang nyan pa dang bsgom pa la sogs pa'i gsang ba bla na med pa'i brtul zhugs dbang thob par 'gyur ro// de nas yang rdo rje sems dpa'i brtul zhugs sbyin par bya'o// oṃ badz+ra sa ta ma ha su kha hūm̐/ zhes pas lag pa g.yas su dam tshig rdo rje byin la/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// rdo rje sems dpa'i lag na bsnams// khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang*// phyag na rdo rje'i brtul zhugs brtan/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sid dha badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha e sha tram̐ dha ra ya mī badz+ra sa twa hi hi hi hi hūm̐/ 'dis ni snga ma'i dbang bskur ba thams cad brtan par byed pa/ rigs drug pa rdo rje sems dpa'i dbang ngo*// 'di lta bu'i bum pa'i dbang bdun po 'di dag gi don 'di nyid rgyud chen po dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi 'grel bar/ ji ltar gzhi la gnas pa'i dri ma 'khrus par byed pa byas pa 'jug pa'i dbang bdun zhes bya ste/ mngal du phung po dang khams dang skye mched grub nas skyes pa dang 'khrus par byed pa dag pa chu dbang*/ gtsug phud 'jog pa dang rna ba 'bugs pa dbu rgyan dang dar dpyangs/ lus kyi spyod lam rnam par dag pa rdo rje'i dbang*/ ngag gi smra ba slob pa dag pa dril bu'i dbang*/ ming gi rtog pa sbyong ba ming gi dbang*/ rang gi bya ba thams cad grub par byed pa brtul zhugs dang rjes su gnang ba'i dbang ste/ 'di dag rnam par sbyangs nas bskyed rdzogs kyi don bsgoms pa phul du phyin par gyur na 'bras bu ni/

sa dang po rab tu dga' ba nas bdun pa'i bar thob par byed par gsungs te/ rgyud 'grel gyi lung mang du gsungs kyang 'dir ma bris so// yang dag pa'i don nyams su len pa dang*/ gzhan slob dpon byed pa la ma rtogs pa/ phal pa rnams la ni/ 'di nyid kyi rjes su lung bstan pa dang*/ rjes su gnang ba sbyin par bya'o// bum pa'i dbang ngo*// de nas dbang gong ma'i snod du gyur pa yang dag pa'i don nyams su len pa rin po che lta bu'i gang zag rnams la yang nas yang du gsol ba gdab pa rnams la sbyin par bya'o// de yang bcom ldan 'das kyis dkyil 'khor rnam pa bzhi gsungs te/ gong gi byis pa 'jug pa'i dbang ni rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bris nas dbang bskur ba'o// lus kyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas gsang pa'i dbang bskur ba'o// bha ga'i dkyil 'khor la brten nas shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba'o// snang srid kyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas/ dbang bzhi pa bskur te/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dbang bcu gcig gis sangs rgyas nyid grub par byed pa rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang du gsungs so/ gsang ba'i dbang bskur ba ni gsol ba gdab pa dang*/ lus kyi dkyil 'khor bstan pa dang*/ dbang bskur ba dang*/ rjes su gnang ba sbyin pa'o// dang po ni gser la sogs pa'i maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ khyod ni mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho ste// bde gshegs rnams kyi bde stsol mdzad// byang chub sems dpa' mchog rnams la// ji ltar de nyid bdud rtsi yi// mchog gi dbang ni bskur ba ltar// de bzhin bdag la'ang stsal du gsol// zhes lan gsum du gsol ba gdab bo// gnyis pa lus kyi dkyil 'khor bstan pa ni/ nges par brjod pa bla ma'i rgyud las/ lus 'di gzhal yas khang yin te// sangs rgyas kun gyis yang dag brten// zur bzhi po ni mdun rgyab dang*// g.yas dang g.yon gyi dbye bas so// steng 'og sgo yi dbye ba yis// sgo bzhi zhes kyang bshad pa yin// zhes bya ba la sogs pa lus kyi dkyil 'khor du gsungs shing gzhan yang*/

rdo rje slob dpon lus 'di la// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rang bzhin gnas// 'di yi gzugs kyi phung po la// de bzhin gshegs pa rnam snang mdzad// 'di yi tshor ba'i phung po la// de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen 'byung*// 'di yi 'du shes phung po ni// de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag med// 'di yi 'du byed phung po la// de bzhin gshegs pa don yod grub// 'di yi rnam shes phung po ni// de bzhin gshegs pa mi bskyod pa'o// zhes bya ba gsungs pas/ rang gi lus la dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis kyi bdag nyid/ 'khor lo gsum la thim pa dang*/ longs spyad pa dag bdag po'i bdun bcu don gnyis kyi phyag dang rgyud rnam par dag pa/ lnga brgya dang bzhi'i lhag pa'i lha thams cad lus kyi rtsa dang thig le byang chub sems kyi ngo bor gnas pa shes par byas la/ 'khor lo rnam pa lnga ni rigs lnga yin pas/ spros pa la dga' na me tog dor ba dang mig 'byed pa dkyil 'khor bstan pa bshad do// dbang bskur ba dngos ni/ rdo rje slob dpon dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho dang dum skyes ma rdo rje phag mo dang gnyis su med pa'i mkha' gsang sbyor ba byas pa'i 'od zer gyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad bsdus nas zhal du zhugs te/ e a ra li dza hūm̐ bam̐ ho sarba bhud dha ḍa ki ni phā+aiṃ zhes sku'i dbyibs brgyud nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu ra ga ta badz+ra swa bha ba ad ma ko ham̐/ zhes pas pad ma'i snod du gnas pa'i bdud rtsi lnga'i rang bzhin lce la bzhag nas/ 'di ni dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma'i// dam tshig rmad byung chen po ste// khams lnga las byung bcud kyis len/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i sbyor ldan pas// phag mo gnyis med byang chub sems// bde ba chen por myang bar gyis// oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes sbyin no// slob mas a ho ma ha su kha'o// zhes btung bar bya'o// 'di yi skabs su rol mo'i sgra dang bcas pas dmigs pa ni gong gi bum pa'i dbang bzhin no// 'di yi don bshad par bya ste/

rgyud las gsungs pa/ ri lu rtag tu mchod pa ni// bdud rtsi gsang ba'i chu yin no// pho nya lhan skyes bdag nyid ni// dbang gnyis sbyor la brtse ba'o// yid ni nang du song ba ni// khams rnams kyang ni zhu ba'o// ri lu thig le sangs rgyas rnams// zhu gang sbyor ba las byung ba'o// sbrang rtsi khrag dang ga pur bcas/ bcu drug 'dod ma la byung ba'o// tshogs dbus rab tu bzhugs rnams kyis// 'di kun lhan skyes la sbyar ba'o// ming med mthe bong khar gzhug pa// snyoms par 'jug las khrag byung ba'o// zhi ba'i btung ba myang ba ni// 'pho ba'i dus las ma lus gang*// 'di rnams bdud rtsi lngar 'gyur ba// 'pho las byung ba'i mi'i mar khu// mchod bzhi de bzhin bya ba ni// bzhi mnyam ga pur bcas pa'o// lha dang mi rnams bde ba ni// dga' ba kun las gar byung ba'o// bcu drug cha shas rin chen pa// thams cad bde ba'i rang bzhin can// de ltar dpa' bo thams cad ni// khams kyi rdzas rnams su sbyar bya// de nas rjes su gnang ba sbyin par bya ste/ 'di ni shin tu gsang chen don// rdo rje'i ye shes las byung pa// dbang bskur ba ni rmad byung che// rdo rje dril bu rnam bsgrags pas// mchog tu dga' bar rtogs byed pa// 'di yi 'gro rnams dgug par bya// ga pur khrag chen bcas pa dang*// tsan dan dmar dang bzhi mnyam bcas// lnga pa rdo rje dri chu ste/ 'chi med bdud rtsi lnga po 'di// gnyis med ye shes sems kyis ni// mi bza' ba ni ci yang med// zhes bya ba sha lnga dang bdud rtsi lnga'i rjes su gnang ba sbyin no// dbang bskur ba 'di ni lus kyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas/ gsang ba'i dbang bskur/ ngag dang rlung rnam par dag nas/ 'jig rten na khyim thab len pa'i rnam par rtog pa sbyong ba/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa bsgoms pas/ sa brgyad pa mi g.yo ba thob par byed pa'o// gsang ba'i dbang ngo*// de nas shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba ni/

'di yi de nyid mi shes pa'i// slob ma rnams la bstan mi bya// blo ldan rnam par rtog med la// legs pas sbas pa 'di sbyin bya// zhes byung pas/ thog mar sngags dang zhing dang rigs las skyes pa'i legs par sbyangs ba'i phyag rgya'am/ yang na rnal 'byor ma'i 'khor lo yid las skyes pa rigs sum cu so drug gi bdag nyid chos 'byung gi dkyil 'khor du legs par bskyed la dbang sbyin par bya ste/ 'di la yang maṇ+ḍal phul zhing gsol ba gdab pa dang*/ dbang bskur ba dang*/ rjes su gnang ba'o// dang po ni/ rin po che la sogs pa'i maṇ+ḍal phul nas gsol ba gdab pa ni/ bdag gi ma'i lha mo kye// lha mo kun gyis rab mchod ma// khyod ni 'di rnams kun gyi ma/ ye shes snying po phyag 'tshal 'dud// sems can kun la snying rje yi// gzugs su rang gis sprul pa mo// bdag la kun du thugs rje yi// bka' drin chen po mdzad par rigs// byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la// dbang mchog dam pa stsal ba ltar// bdag kyang bskyab pa'i don gyi phyir// nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag stsol// zhes gsol ba lan gsum gdab nas/ slob ma rnams he ru ka dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtshor mos pa byas la/ dngos su bkod pa ma yin pa/ sin dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor du dpa' mo sum cu so bdun gyi sa bon bskyed pa la mchod pa dang bstod pa byas te/ chos kyi 'byung gnas kyi dkyil 'khor gyi sgo rnam par dag pa la rnam par thar pa'i sgo gsum la zur gsum/ sangs rgyas kyi yon tan gong nas gong du 'phags pa'i gzhal yas nas/ rdo rje phag mo dum skyes ma rnal 'byor ma'i 'khor lo dang bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor bstan cing*/ me tog dor ba bya ste/ rdo rje phag mo 'phro ba'i sbyin par bya ste/ 'di ni khyod kyi gzungs ma mchog /bsten par sangs rgyas rnams kyis brtags// 'khor lo'i rim pa sbyor ba yis// bde ba yang dag myong bar gyis// thabs gzhan gyis ni sangs rgyas min// 'gro ba gsum po 'di yis dag

/de phyir 'di dang mi 'bral zhing*// khyod kyis nam yang mi btang ngo*// 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// rig ma'i brtul zhugs bla na med// rmongs pas gang zhig 'da' byed na// de la mchog gi dngos grub med// zhes brjod nas sbyin par bya// de la rdo rje phag mo dum skyes ma// dri zhim me tog phreng rgyan ma// rjes su bstan pa gsal bar smra// gang gi bdud rtsi lnga rnams ni// rlung gis de nyid sbyor ldan pas// rnam par mi rtog bza' byed dam// bde ba chen po'i mkha' 'di ni// sangs rgyas kun gyis byin gyis brlabs// gang zhig cho ga bzhin bsten na// yang dag sangs rgyas mnyes byed de// bde chen rgyal po rang nyid ni// 'di nyid kyi ni yang dag bzhugs// bde ba chen po'i don rtogs na// de yi mdun du nga gnas so// zhes bya ba'i tshigs su bcad pa gsungs lhag par mos pa byas la/ de nas slob mas brjod par bya ba ni/ ji ltar gsungs pa'i dam tshig kun// bdag ni legs par bsrung par bgyid// rnam par mi rtog rang bzhin gyi// mkha' 'gro rnams la gus par bgyid/ zhes brjod nas/ rgyud las gsungs pa'i/ yi ger brgyar ni snying rtser yang dag ldan// bh+ya ni mtshan gyi lte ba rnam par bkod// lte ba snying dang kha dang dpral ba ru// sngags dang tshogs dang bcas pas byin gyis rlobs// rnal 'byor ma dang dpa' bo gnyis med de// zhes gsungs pa'i don bsgom par bya'o// rgyud las kyang*/ sgra dang gzugs su yongs byung pa// khrag khu nor bu'i bar dag tu// 'jig rten gsum du rnyed dka' ba// rang rig pad mar son pa'o// srub dang srub pa'i sbyor rnams kyis// rang byung gis ni rnams bsres pa'o// dbus ma'i mchog gi dbugs kyang ni// skad cig dbu mar bzung ba'o// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ yang nang gi dam tshig gi phyag rgya bsgom pa ni/ lte ba'i dkyil 'khor nyid gnas pa// rgod ma'i me 'dra ngo bo ni// phag mo'i thig ler 'dod pa ste// dpyid thob nas ni tshim 'gyur ro// snyoms par 'jug pas yang dag gnas// 'di ni he ru ka dpal lo// zhes bya bas/

lte ba'i gtum mo'i me 'bar nas/ spyi bo'i haṃ byang chub kyi sems zhu bas/ dga' ba dang*/ mchog dga' dang*/ dga' bral dang*/ lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba bsgom par bya'o// de nas rjes su gnang ba ni/ dus 'di nas ni bzung nas ni// ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar// phyag rgya bzhi yi sbyor ba yis// rmi 'drar sems can thams cad kyi// don ni dpa' bo khyod kyis gyis// 'dod chags bral ba lta bu'i sdig /khams gsum na ni gzhan med do// de bas 'dod la chags bral bar// khyod kyis nam yang mi bya'o// zhes gsungs pa 'khor ba pa bzhin du 'dzag bzhin pa'i chags pa dang bral ba lta bu dang*/ nyan rang lta bur sems can gyi don la chags pa dang bral ba gnyis ka spangs la/ srid pa dang zhi ba gnyis ka'i dam tshig rtogs par bya'o// shes rab ye shes kyi dbang ngo*// da ni dbang bzhi pa phyag rgya chen po'i dbang la bzhi/ maṇ+ḍal phul nas gsol ba gdab pa dang*/ dbang bskur ba dngos dang*/ de'i don bstan pa'o// dang po ni maṇ+ḍal dang rang gi lus longs spyod dang bcas pa bla ma la phul nas/ gsol ba gdab pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang gi bka' drin gyis// 'dir ni dbang bskur rnam gsum thob// stong nyid shes rab mdzes pa yis// bzhi pa'i bka' drin bskyab tu gsol// zhes lan gsum du gsol ba gdab bo/ dbang dngos ni/ rang rig pa'i ye shes de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ngo bo lus dag pa'i bsam gtan dang*/ ngag dag par byed pa'i 'dzin pa dang*/ thig le dag par byed pa'i ye shes kyi gtum mo ste/ rtsa ba'i rgyud las gsungs pa/ bdag nyid rnams kyi bsgom pa'i lam// de kho na nyid las dam 'khyud ma// skyob pa rnams kyis grol ba'i lam// mtho ris mi yul sa 'og gi /grol ba rnam pa gsum zhes bya// mnyam pa'i bde ba mthong 'gyur ba'ang*/ rdo rje 'bar ba'i mtshams na gnas// bum pa can sogs byas gang phyi// gtum mo phra ba'i rtsa can no// pad ma rtsar ni thams cad can// de dang 'dra ba'i ye shes med// de phyir brtson 'grus 'byung bar 'gyur// stobs bcu ye shes ye shes can// de ltar shes byas rtag rnal 'byor// 'dod can ma la 'dod spyod kyis// dkyil 'khor gyi ni bdag mo dang*// gsang sngags yi ger yang dag byung*// lhan skyes rdzogs byang chub mchog tu/

lha mo chen mor skye bar 'gyur// zhes gsungs pas/ khams gsum pa'i gzhal yas kyi khang par lus mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i bskyed rims dang ldan pas/ lus kyi gnad bsam gtan gyi chos rnam pa lnga dang ldan pas skye ba dang 'gag pa med pa snang ba dang stong pa gnyis su med pa'i de kho na nyid kyi phyag rgya dam pa dang 'khyud nas/ skyob pa sangs rgyas rnams kyis gsungs pa'i rnal 'byor gsum gyi lam bsgom par bya ste/ sa 'og sku'i rdo rje/ mi yul gsung gi rdo rje/ mtho ris thugs kyi rdo rje grol bar byed pa'i thabs/ bde ba dang stong pa mnyam pa'i rang bzhin/ bsgom pa'i tshul yang rdo rje stong pa nyid kyi nam mkha' la/ rnam par mi rtog pa'i sems bzung bas/ 'bar ba la sogs pa'i rtags rnam pa bcu mthong ba la brten nas/ lus dag par byed do// bum pa can la sogs pa'i srog rtsol gyi sbyor ba byas pas ngag dag par byed do/ phyi nas gtum mo phra mo'i rnal 'byor rjes su dran pa bsgoms pas sems dag par byed do// rnam pa gsum po 'di las lhag pa'i ye shes med de/ de'i phyir brtson 'grus dang stobs dang ye shes kyi rnal 'byor pa 'di 'dra dus rtag tu spyod pas 'dod can ma la longs spyad pas/ 'di ni dkyil 'khor gyi bdag mo rdo rje phag mo'o// gsang sngags yi ger yang dag byung*// zhes bya ba/ ma na yid/ tra ya skyob pa ste/ yid bde stong du byin gyis brlabs pa dang yi ger ni a k+ṣa ra zhes bya ste/ 'gyur ba med pa'i phyag rgya chen mo'i lhan cig skyes pa rtogs nas bla nas bla na med pa'i byang chub thob par 'gyur ro// 'di ltar nyams su len pa'i tshul ni/ dbang bzhi pa'o// de nyid kyi rgyas gdab pa rgyud las gsungs pa/ dkyil 'khor bde ba chen po bsgom par gyis// rnal 'byor bcu gnyis bsod nams sdig med pa'o// thams cad zag med rang bzhin mos par gyis/
