dkyil 'khor ngan pa de ni bde bar shes par byos// dbang po 'khrul pa bde ba chen mor mos par gyis// skad cig de la rang dang gzhan gyi ngo bo med// gang gi rnam pa sna tshogs gzugs chen gyis// sa gsum du ni dkyil 'khor spro bar byos// zhes gsung pa'i don rnams go bar bya'o// dbang bzhi pa'o// dbang gong ma gnyis po 'di dag gis/ 'jig rten pa'i gnas skabs bzhi dag par byas nas/ 'bras bu sa dgu pa dang sa bcu pa thob par 'gyur ro// de ltar mthar phyin pa'i slob ma/ rdo rje slob dpon du 'gyur bas/ de'i dbang bshad do// dbang thams cad rdzogs pa'i rjes su/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang bskur ba'i dbang gi stegs bu pad ma 'dab brgyad pa phyi rol du re ga rnam pa lnga dang ldan pa seng ge'i khri bshams te/ steng du gdugs dkar po bzung ba dang*/ ba dan dang 'phan la sogs pa mchod pa'i bye brag bshams la/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang gi gsol ba gdab pa dang*/ dam tshig gsum byin pa dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa rjes gnang dang*/ thun mong gi rjes su gnang ba'o// dang po ni rin po che gser la sogs pa'i maṇ+ḍal phul nas gsol ba gdab pa ni/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i sbyor ldan pa'i// slob dpon bdag la dgongs su gsol// bla ma mchog gi bka' drin gyis// rang gzhan don ni nus 'gyur ba// rdo rje slob dpon gyi ni dbang*// thugs rje ldan pa bdag la stsol// zhes lan gsum du gsol ba btab nas/ slob ma rnams dbang gi stegs bu la bzhag nas/ dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i rnal 'byor gsal bar bsgoms la/ thog mar bum pa'i chu yis khrus bya zhing*/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni// khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa// sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum gyi// gnas las byung ba sbyin par bya// rtsa ba'i sngags kyi gsham du oṃ ā bhi shiñtsa tu mam̐ zhes brjod do// phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyis dbu rgyan bskon par bsams la/

oṃ rad na mu ku traṃ/ zhes dbu rgyan sbyin no// de nas sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig sbyin par bya ste/ lag pa g.yas su rdo rje byin te/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni// rdo rje sems dpa' rgyal po che// kun du bzang po kun bdag nyid// rdo rje snyems tshul bdag po'i bdag /oṃ badz+ra sa twa hūm̐ zhes byin nas/ lag pa g.yon du dril bu byin la/ chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong bsgrags bsam pa byas la/ srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag /ngo bo nyid kyis srid bral byas// rang bzhin dag pa'i sems dpa' ni// srid pa'i dam pa byed par 'gyur// oṃ dhar rma dhar du aḥ de nas rdo rje dril bu 'khyud pa'i tshul du bya zhing*/ yid kyi lus ni brtan bya'i phyir// phyag rgya'i dam tshig zhes su bshad// gang gi thams cad skur bstan pa// des na phyag rgyar rab tu grags// rang gi lha yi sbyor ba yis// rang gzhan mchod pa nyid du bya// ji srid 'khor ba'i gnas 'dug pa// rtul phod mang po 'gyur ba yis// de srid sems can mnyam med don// mya ngan mi 'da' nus par gyis// 'di ni sku'i dam tshig bla na med pa'o// de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang dngos ni/ thabs dang shes rab sbyor ba yis// rdo rje dril bu rnam par zung*// de ring rdo rje slob dpon gyur// slob ma'i tshogs rnams bsdu bar gyis// cho ga bzhin du khyod kyis ni// dkyil 'khor dam pa bri bar bya// sngags dang rgyud kyang 'dzin pa khyod// rdo rje 'dzin pa bdag nyid che// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' rnams// ma lus lus pa med 'grub 'gyur// deng nas bzung ste dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i sbyor bas/ dbang bskur ba dang*/ rgyud bshad pa dang*/ las bzhi dang*/ grub pa chen po brgyad sems can gyi don byos shig oṃ ma ha su kha badz+ra swa ta a bhi she ke na twam̐ a bhi shin tsā mi sarba ta thā ga ta a dhi pa ti te na dhi dho me bha ba sid dh+ya na ma te bha ga wan ma hā badz+ra dha ra/

su ra stam̐ a haṃ badz+ra sa twa oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra a bhi shin tsa/ de nas mchod pa rnams mchod nas/ bkra shis brjod de/ mnga' bdag sku mdog sngon po rgyal gyur cig /dmar pos ji ltar mdzes byas rgyal gyur cig /dam tshig gis brgyan mdzes pa rgyal gyur cig /zla phyed dbu la brgyan par rgyal gyur cig /lha mo'i 'khor los brgyan pa rgyal gyur cig /dang po sangs rgyas sku mchog gnas pa rgyal gyur cig /'dod pa thar pa nor dang chos sbyin rgyal gyur cig /rnam par dgyes rol rang bzhin rgyal gyur cig /phyag na rdo rje bde ba'i mgon po rgyal gyur cig /zhes me tog dor zhing brjod nas/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang gi dngos gzhi'o// thun mong ma yin pa'i rjes gnang la drug ste/ dang po gzugs thams cad kyi rjes su gnang ba ni/ gzugs brnyan rnams ni rnam pa ltar// snang la rang bzhin med pa yi// chos kun de ltar shes nas ni// sna tshogs snang ba'i chos rnams don// rnal 'byor ldan pas shes nas ni// sems can kun la bstan par gyis// zhes so// gnyis pa sgra thams cad kyi rjes su gnang ba ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi// sgra yi rjes su 'gro ba yi// shes rab sngon du rtogs gyis la// 'jig rten khams rnams thams cad du// kun du sgra snyan lta bu yis// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar gyis// zhes brjod de pi wang sbyin no// gsum pa dri'i rjes su gnang ba ni/ snying khar dri'i thig le byas te/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi// skye med lhag par rtogs gyur cig /gang gis sangs rgyas zhing kun dang*// 'jig rten kun du bla med pa'i// bsam mi khyab pa'i tshul khrims 'di// rang gi lus las spro bar byos// zhes so// bzhi pa ro'i rjes su gnang ba bdud rtsi lngas sbyar ba'i amṛ ta byin la/ ro kun rang bzhin med pa yi// cig gi rnam par rtogs kyis la// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*// srog chags gyur pa thams cad la// lha rdzas dpe med ro yi mchog

/ro kun rang bzhin med pa yi// sprul nas su ni sbyin par byos// zhes so// lnga pa reg bya thams cad kyi rjes su gnang ba ni/ lha mo'i reg bya dang ldan pa'i// lha yi gos ni byin byas te// gang gis reg bya'i khyad par rnams// rang gi sems la byung ba ste// snang yang rang bzhin med par ni// bde ba dam pa rtogs gyis la// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*// srog chags gyur pa thams cad la// kun sbyor reg bya'i bde ba yi// sprul nas su ni sbyin par byos// zhes so// drug pa chos kyi gnang ba ni/ me long bstan la/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste// dag cing gsal la rnyog pa med// bzung du med cing brjod du med// rgyu dang las la kun du byung*/ de ltar shes byas chos 'di ni// rang bzhin med pa rnyog pa med// sems can don ni mnyam med kyis// skyob pa rnams kyi rigs su skye// zhes brjod nas/ yul drug po rnams sgyu ma dang rmi lam du shes pas sems can gyi don byos shig ces brjod do// thun mong gi rjes su gnang ba ni/ gsang sngags dang rus pa'i rgyan rjes su gnang ba dang*/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i rjes gnang dang*/ thun mong gi rjes gnang phran dang*/ dam tshig gi rjes gnang dang*/ lung bstan/ dbugs dbyung*/ gzeng bstod do// dang po ni/ rus pa'i rgyan gsang sngags kyis byin gyis brlabs la rim pa bzhin du byin te/ oṃ ham̐ badz+ra ḍa ki hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra bā+ai ro tsa na ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ hri ha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ 'khor lo'am gzugs kyi mi bskyod pa// rnam snang mdzad ma'i sngags gang yang*// thod pa'i dbu rgyan byas pa'o// yi ge bdun pa'i gsang sngags kyis// gdub bskor gyi ni rna ba mdzes// rna cha 'od dpag med pa'ang yin// oṃ sarba bud dha ḍa ki ni ye hūm̐ phaṭa/ sangs rgyas kun gyi mkha' 'gro ma'i// lpags pa 'i gos mchog 'dzin pa yin// oṃ shri badz+ra he he ru ru kam̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/

ḍa ki ni dza la sam̐ bha ra swāhā/ dpa' bo rtsa ba'i sngags sogs gang*// tshangs pa'i skud sogs nyid du 'dod// oṃ badz+ra war rna ni ye hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ tram̐/ mgul gyi phreng ba rin chen bdag /oṃ bam̐/ ham̐ yam̐/ hriṃ mam̐/ hriṃ hriṃ/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ rnal 'byor ma drug gsang sngags kyis// ske rags byas te brgyan pa'o// oṃ ha/ na ma hi/ swa ha hu/ bā+o sha ḍa he/ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho/ phaṭa ham̐/ lag gdub rnam snang mdzad sogs te// ske rags la ni don yod gnas/ oṃ ṭa ki ni ye/ ru pi ni ye/ khan dha ro hi ye/ la ma ye hūm̐ phaṭa/ 'khor lo kun gyi rnal 'byor ma'i// sngags ni btung ba'i thod pa yin// 'di ltar bdag nyid rnams bsams nas// 'tsham mam sngags kyis shin tu bsrung*// rtag tu tshangs pa spyod gyur pa// rkang pa brgyad pa'i sngags kyis mchod// 'di ltar rgyud las byung ba'i don rnams legs par dran par byas nas/ oṃ 'khor lo thod pa rna cha dang*// mgul rgyan gdu bu ske rags dang*// tshangs skud dang ni rnam bdun te// phyag rgya yis ni dbang bskur ro// zhes rgyan gyis rjes su gnang ba'o// de nas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i rjes gnang ni/ 'khor lo lag tu byin la/ rnam par snang mdzad kyis sems can gyis don byed do// bsam pa byed du bcug ste/ 'jig rten khams ni thams cad du// sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir// gti mug thabs kyis 'dul gyur pa// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar gyis// oṃ dha rma tsakra pra bar dha ya mi/ de bzhin du/ zhe sdang 'dul ba'i 'khor lo rdo rje dang*/ ser sna 'dul ba'i rin po che'i 'khor lo dang*/ 'dod chags can 'dul ba'i pad ma'i 'khor lo dang*/ phrag dog can 'dul ba'i rdo rje las kyi 'khor lo bskor*/ zhes brjod la/ rjes su/ oṃ badz+ra tsakra pra bar dha ya hūm̐/ oṃ rad na tsakra pra bar dha ya tram̐ḥ oṃ pad ma pra bar dha ya hriḥ oṃ karma tsakra pra bar dha ya kham̐/

de nas po ti dang dung lag tu byin la/ khyod kyi the tshom dogs med par// yid gnyis med pa'i sems kyis ni// chos kyi dung ni bla na med// dri ma med pa kun du khong*// chos kyi spyod pa'i tshul mchog 'di// rang gi mnyam med rab tu ston// bya ba shes shing sangs rgyas kun/ rtag tu khyod la bsrung bar 'gyur// zhes brjod par bya'o// chos kyi 'khor lo'i rjes su gnang ba'o// de nas thun mong gi rjes gnang phra mo ni/ dang por glu dang gar gyi rjes su gnang pa ni/ lus can rnams la dam chos ni// khyod kyis glu ni blang bar gyis// de nas rnal 'byor ma de dang*// myur du bde ba myong bar 'gyur// deng nas brtsams te rdzogs sangs rgyas// sras dang bcas te rnam rol pa// shes rab thabs kyis snyems chen gyis// gar mchog bde ba'i dga' ston gyis// zhes brjod do// gnyis pa phreng ba'i rjes gnang la/ sgeg dang bcas pa phreng ba 'chang*// sangs rgyas tshogs dang rnal 'byor ma// de ni 'bral bar mi 'gyur te// phreng ba 'di ni rgyan yin no// gsum pa dri bzang po dang spos kyi rjes gnang ni/ khyod kyis rgyal la dri phul bas// tshul khrims ting 'dzin shes rab dang*/ rnam grol ye shes mthong pa yi// byang chub lus can rnams la bsgo// khyod kyis rgyal la spos phul la// brtul zhugs bzang po legs tshim gyis// lus can bde gshegs cha lugs su// rang bzhin gyis ni 'grub par 'gyur// bzhi pa mar me'i rjes gnang ni/ chos kyi mar me legs sbar bas// pad+ma gar dbang rang nyid de// 'gro rnams ma rig mdongs pa la// ye shes sgron me spar bar gyis// de nas gser gyi thur ma sman dang bcas pa byin la/ ji ltar mig mkhan rgyal po yis// 'jig rten rab rib bsal ba ltar// bu khyod kyis ni mi shes pa'i// rab rib rgyal ba rnams kyis bsal// oṃ badz+ra ne tra a pa ha ra pa tam̐ laṃ hriḥs ho zhes brjod nas mda' gzhu lag tu byin la bdud rnams 'bigs par byed pa'i bsam pas/

shes rab thabs kyi sbyor ba yis// phyogs bzhi rnams dang steng 'og tu// skyob pa'i thabs kyis sbyor ba yis/ bdud bzhi rnam par gzhom par bya// sarba ta thā ga ta a nu ra ga yā swaḥ bdun pa 'phrin las kyi rjes gnang la/ zhi dang rgyas dang dbang dang dgug /sdang bar bya dang gnod sogs dang*// bsad dang bskrad pa la sogs pa'i// las de rnams ni bsgrub par gyis// ral gri mig sman sa 'og dang*// ri lu mi snang mkha' spyod dang*// gnod sbyin mo dang bcud kyis len// de yang ci dga' grub par gyis// thun mong gi rjes su gnang ba'o// dam tshig gi rjes su gnang ba la/ mkhas pas dam tshig bsgrags par bya// thabs dang shes rab sems kyi ni// mi bya ba ni ci yang med// rtag tu dogs med byas gyur nas// 'dod pa lnga la longs spyod bya// ji lta ji ltar 'dul 'gyur ba// sems can de yi rang bzhin gyi// de lta de ltar sems can don// 'dod chags sogs pas dag par bya// gang gzhan dam tshig la sdang pa// dam tshig nyams pa'i skye bo dang*// 'bad pa yis ni bsad par bya// sangs rgyas bstan pa skyong ba la// sems can kun la phan don phyir// sangs rgyas rnal 'byor rab sbyor bas// pha rol po yi sems phrogs kyang*// sdig pas gos par mi 'gyur ro// 'dod chags lta bu'i bde med pas// skye bo rnams la rtag tu sbyin// sems can don du gzhan bud med// bsten pas bsod nams thob par 'gyur// sangs rgyas la sogs smod pa la// rin chen 'byung ldan rnal 'byor gyis// tshig ni rtsub po la sogs pa// bla med dngos grub thob par 'gyur// 'od dpag med kyi brdzun ngag smra// don yod grub mchog ting 'dzin gyis// blo ldan rgyu sogs cho ga yin// dam tshig dag pa bsten par bya// 'di dag ni mchog gi dam tshig zhes su bshad do// gzhan yang rgyud thams cad kyi nang na dam tshig nye bar bsdus pa/

bla ma dam pa mi brnyas dang*// bde gshegs bka' las mi 'da' zhing*// rdo rje spun la khro mi bya// 'gro la byams pa mi spang zhing*// byang chub sems ni nyams mi bya// rang gzhan grub mtha' la mi smad// gsang ba ma smin la mi bsgrag /rang gi phung po brnyas mi bya// dag pa'i chos la som nyi spangs// gdug pa can la byams mi bya// ming bral don gyi sgro 'dogs spang*// dad ldan sems can sun mi dbyung*// dam tshig rnyed pa mi spang zhing*// shes rab bud med smad mi bya// gal te 'gal bar gyur pa na// rtsa ba'i ltung ba bcu bzhir 'gyur/ dam med rig ma mi bsten dang*// tshogs kyi 'khor lor brtsod mi bya// ma gsungs pa yi rig ma las// dam tshig bdud rtsi blang mi bya// gsang chos dus ldan bstan par bya// chos 'dri bre mo'i gtam mi bya// nyan thos nang du zhag bdun min// rnal 'byor ye shes mi shes par// rdo rje 'dzin par khas mi blang*// 'di ltar tshangs spyod nyi shu gnyis// nyams pa med par rab bsten nas// rdo rje sems dpa'i go 'phang 'gyur// zhes rgyas bsdus ci rigs kyis bstan par bya'o// de nas lung bstan pa ni/ slob dpon dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i gzugs kyis/ lag pa g.yon pas chos gos bzung nas seng ge'i rna ltar byas te/ g.yas pa mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgya byas la lung bstan te/ de ring ngas khyod lung bstan te// rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs// srid pa shin tu dag bya'i phyir// srid pa'i ngan 'gro las bton no/ oṃ na ma sarba ta thā ga ta sid dhi sa ma ya stoṃ bhur bhu wa swa/ kye dpal rdo rje che ge mo zhes bya ba ma 'ongs pa'i dus su gsang ba'i mtshan dang mthun pa'i de bzhin gshegs par 'gyur ro// zhes lung bstan no// dbugs dbyung ba ni/ gsang mchog dkyil 'khor dam par ni// mthong nas su ni rab zhugs pas// sdig pa kun las rnam par grol// de ring legs par gnas par gyur// bde chen theg pa 'di las ni/

slar yang 'ching ba yod ma yin// mi tshugs pa dang mi chod par/ 'jigs pa med pas rol par gyis// srid pa'i sdug bsngal kun las 'das// srid pa shin tu dag pa'i phyir/ dngos grub dam tshig sdom pa ni// 'di ni rtag tu bsrung bar gyis// zhes gsungs pas/ rdo rje theg pa las rab tu zhugs nas 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las rnam par grol bar gyur to// gzengs bstod par bya ste/ 'di ltar dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor chen por/ dbang bskur ba thob nas/ sangs rgyas su 'gyur bas the tshom med de/ de ring rdo rje 'dzin bcas pa// sangs rgyas kun gyis dbang bskur ba// khams gsum gyi ni rgyal srid che// rgyal po bdag pos gnas pa yin// de ring bdud las rgyal byas nas// grong khyer mchog tu rab tu zhugs// de ring sangs rgyas nyid thob par// khyod nyid 'gyur ba the tshom med// zhes gsungs pas/ ma 'ongs pa'i dus na khams gsum thams cad dbang zhing*/ chos kyi 'khor lo bsgyur ba'i rgyal po 'khor lo bcu gnyis kyi mnga' bdag dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho he ru ka'i go 'phang thob par 'gyur to// lung bstan pa dang dbugs dbyung ba dang gzengs bstod pa'i cho ga'o// de nas slob mas/ bla ma'i zhabs gnyis la phyag 'tshal nas/ me tog dang bcas pa'i thal mos/ de ring bdag skyes bur bcas// gang der legs par rab tu gnas// dam tshig lha rnams dang mnyam mo// rang byung du ni da ltar skyes// ji ltar gsungs shing bstan pa kun// bdag gis de ltar bgyid par 'tshal// zhes brjod do// rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang gi cho ga dang*/ rjes su gnang ba dang bcas pa'i cho ga'o// rdo rje slob dpon mchod pa'i cho ga dang*/ dkyil 'khor gshegs su gsol ba ni/ dang po rgyud las gsungs pa/ slob dpon mchod bya yang dag par// rdo rje 'chang du byas nas ni// mu tig gser dang rin chen rnams// glang rta sa gzhi yul ljongs dang*// bran pho bran mo 'khor rnams dang*// chung ma phun sum tshogs kun dang*// gos zung du ma rnams dang ni/

dgyes pa'am sa la gang cung zad// bdag tu lta ba dang bral bas// dbul bya gtso bor zhi bar gyis// bdag nyid dngos po thams cad kyis// phyag byas nas ni dbul bar bya// zhes gsungs pa'i rim pa bzhin ci nus kyis rdo rje slob dpon mchod par bya'o// gnyis pa dkyil 'khor gshegs su gsol ba la/ gong gi dbang bskur ba byas nas/ gtor ma'i cho ga las byung ba bzhin du/ 'byung po rnams la gtor ma sbyin no// dge slong dang dge 'dun 'dus pa'i tshogs la dga' ston byas te/ dkyil 'khor ba thams cad la phyi dang nang gi mchod pa dang bstod pa byas nas/ mkhyen par gsol ba ni/ gang yang skye bo'i dngos gyur dang*// ma rnyed rnal 'byor dbang phyir dang*// nye bar dgongs pa ma tshang pa'am// dran pa rab tu rmongs byas pa/ de dag bzod par mdzad du gsol// mkhyen par gsol nas/ gshegs su gsol ba ni/ oṃ khyed kyi sems can don kun mdzad// rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol// sangs rgyas yul du gshegs su gsol// slar yang byon par mdzad du gsol/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra muḥzhes brjod nas/ 'od zer gyis khams gsum pa thams cad la phog nas/ slar 'od zer gyi tshul du bsdus nas rang gi lus la thim par bltas la/ dbus kyi rdul tshon blangs te/ spyi bor bzhag nas thams cad legs par bsdus la/ gzhan mchod pa rnams la sbyin par bya/ lhag ma thams cad bum par bsdus te/ las thams cad pa'i bum pa dang mchod pa'i tshogs kyis bskor nas chu bo'i 'gram du bskyal la/ chu bo'i 'gram der pad ma 'dab brgyad pa bris pa'i steng du rdul tshon bzhag la/ mchod bstod byas nas/ klu rnams kyis gdan drangs par bsams la chu bo la dor ro// slar yang bum pa legs par bshams nas chu gtsang mas bkang la/ gnas khang du khrus byas bkra shis brjod do// dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po'i ma smin pa smin par byed pa'i dbang gi cho ga

/grub pa'i slob dpon pad ma badz+ra'i zhal snga nas dang*/ ka ma la dhe nu las rim par byung ba/ paṇa ṭi ta dza ya se na'i cho ga ltar snyigs ma'i dus na gangs can gyi rgyud du byung ba rdo rje'i theg pa'i tshul cung zad rig cing mos pa lam du byed pa rol pa'i rdo rje'i ming can gyi/ gsang sngags kyi blo gros rgyas shing dge ba'i bshes gnyen du ma rnams kyis bskul ba dang bla ma'i man ngag zab mo rgyud 'grel gyi dbus su 'thor ba rnams don du gnyer ba'i skyes bu rnams la phan 'dags pa'i don du bris pa'o// dpal ldan rgyud rgyal bla med rgyud kyi legs par gsungs pa gang de'i// rgyal sras sems dpa' mkhas grub rnams kyis legs par spel bar mdzad pa dang*// snod dang ldan pa'i gdul bya rnams la smin par mdzad pa'i don byung ba// bla ma'i man ngag bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun rang byung rdo rjes spel ba yin// 'di las byung ba'i dge ba ci yod pa// rigs ldan skyes tha rnams kyis rtogs pa dang*// nam mkha'i mthas gtugs gyur pa'i sems can rnams// rdo rje 'chang gi ye shes rtogs par shog cung zad 'gal 'khrul ldan par gyur srid na/ bla ma mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la bzod par gsol/ brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang ba gsang ba'i bdag po dang*// spyan ras gzigs dbang pad ma badz+ra yi// gsung zer pad ma'i myu gus 'grel mdzad de// sha ba ri dang a ba dhu ti pa// rnal 'byor dbang phyug ka ma la badz+ra// mkhas mchog dza ya se nas rin chen bdun// spros mdzad rgyud 'grel gdams par bcas pa rnams// sgra bsgyur dpal mchog dang po'i rdo rje dang*// dar ma yon tan gnyis kyis legs par bsgyur// bla ma rgya dang saṃ ga lak+ṣa la/ sgrub thabs yan lag bcas pa kho bos thos// rgya yi slob ma bsgrad pas tshul rin la/ 'grel bshad dbang bkar bcas pa brgyud pa yin// gzhan yang rgyud kyang lung gi brgyud pa ni// dar ma yon tan sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta// skyob pa dpal dang mnga' ris pa dang ni// rin spungs snyal sde tshul khrims rin chen la// rang byung rdo rje zhes byas gsal bar thos// bdag gis rgya cher gzhan la bsgrags pa yin// stag lo zla ba bdun pa'i tshes brgyad la/
